+"""Serialized, broker-neutral authorization for order-affecting commands.
+
+The coordinator owns only short-lived authorization and cash-reservation state.
+It deliberately does not persist intents, call a broker, or submit orders.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import inspect
+from collections.abc import Awaitable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import Any, Protocol, TypeVar
+
+__all__ = [
+    "OrderCommandCoordinator",
+    "OrderCommand",
+    "CommandDecision",
+    "DecisionReason",
+    "CashReservation",
+    "ReservationLedger",
+    "ExecutionKey",
+]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_T = TypeVar("_T")
+
+
+class _Clock(Protocol):
+    def now(self) -> datetime: ...
+
+
+class _IntentLike(Protocol):
+    execution_mode: object
+    account_key: str
+    symbol: str
+    purpose: object
+    signal_expires_at: datetime
+    quote_reference_time: datetime
+    qty: Decimal | None
+    notional: Decimal | None
+    limit_price: Decimal | None
+
+
+class _QuoteAgeProvider(Protocol):
+    def quote_age(
+        self, intent: _IntentLike, now: datetime
+    ) -> timedelta | Awaitable[timedelta]: ...
+
+
+class _OpenOrderProvider(Protocol):
+    def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool | Awaitable[bool]: ...
+
+
+class _PositionProvider(Protocol):
+    def confirmed_long_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+    def committed_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+    def protective_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+
+class _AvailableCashProvider(Protocol):
+    def available_cash(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+
+async def _resolve(value: _T | Awaitable[_T]) -> _T:
+    if inspect.isawaitable(value):
+        return await value
+    return value
+
+
+def _enum_text(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string or string-valued enum")
+    return raw.strip().upper()
+
+
+def _text(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _decimal(value: object, *, field: str, positive: bool = False) -> Decimal:
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError(f"{field} must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
+    if value < _ZERO or (positive and value == _ZERO):
+        operator = "> 0" if positive else ">= 0"
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be {operator}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _aware(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ExecutionKey:
+    """Strict isolation key for one mode, account/scenario, and symbol."""
+
+    mode: str
+    account_id: str
+    symbol: str
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "mode", _enum_text(self.mode, field="mode"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "account_id", _text(self.account_id, field="account_id"))
+        symbol = _text(self.symbol, field="symbol").upper()
+        if any(character.isspace() for character in symbol):
+            raise ValueError("symbol must not contain whitespace")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_intent(cls, intent: _IntentLike) -> ExecutionKey:
+        return cls(intent.execution_mode, intent.account_key, intent.symbol)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+
+    @property
+    def account_scope(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
+        return (self.mode, self.account_id)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class OrderCommand:
+    """An intent plus coordinator-only reservation/cancellation instructions."""
+
+    intent: _IntentLike
+    reservation_amount: Decimal | None = None
+    cancel_protective_first: bool = False
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        # Structural validation keeps this module independent of f.1's concrete intent.
+        for field in (
+            "execution_mode",
+            "account_key",
+            "symbol",
+            "purpose",
+            "signal_expires_at",
+            "quote_reference_time",
+            "qty",
+            "notional",
+            "limit_price",
+        ):
+            if not hasattr(self.intent, field):
+                raise TypeError(f"intent must provide {field}")
+        if self.reservation_amount is not None:
+            _decimal(self.reservation_amount, field="reservation_amount", positive=True)
+        if not isinstance(self.cancel_protective_first, bool):
+            raise TypeError("cancel_protective_first must be bool")
+
+    @property
+    def key(self) -> ExecutionKey:
+        return ExecutionKey.from_intent(self.intent)
+
+    @property
+    def purpose(self) -> str:
+        return _enum_text(self.intent.purpose, field="purpose")
+
+    @property
+    def requested_cash(self) -> Decimal:
+        if self.reservation_amount is not None:
+            return self.reservation_amount
+        if self.intent.notional is not None:
+            return _decimal(self.intent.notional, field="intent.notional", positive=True)
+        if self.intent.qty is not None and self.intent.limit_price is not None:
+            quantity = _decimal(self.intent.qty, field="intent.qty", positive=True)
+            price = _decimal(self.intent.limit_price, field="intent.limit_price", positive=True)
+            return quantity * price
+        raise ValueError(
+            "ENTRY_LONG requires reservation_amount, notional, or qty with limit_price"
+        )
+
+
+class DecisionReason(Enum):
+    AUTHORIZED = "AUTHORIZED"
+    REJECTED_STALE_SIGNAL = "REJECTED_STALE_SIGNAL"
+    REJECTED_STALE_QUOTE = "REJECTED_STALE_QUOTE"
+    REJECTED_INSUFFICIENT_CASH = "REJECTED_INSUFFICIENT_CASH"
+    REJECTED_OPEN_ORDER = "REJECTED_OPEN_ORDER"
+    REJECTED_OVERSELL = "REJECTED_OVERSELL"
+    REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL = "REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class CashReservation:
+    """Immutable receipt for cash held in a single account-scoped ledger."""
+
+    reservation_id: str
+    execution_key: ExecutionKey
+    amount: Decimal
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "reservation_id", _text(self.reservation_id, field="reservation_id")
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.execution_key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("execution_key must be ExecutionKey")
+        _decimal(self.amount, field="amount", positive=True)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class CommandDecision:
+    reason: DecisionReason
+    key: ExecutionKey
+    purpose: str
+    reservation: CashReservation | None = None
+    available_cash: Decimal | None = None
+    available_quantity: Decimal | None = None
+    protective_quantity: Decimal | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(self.reason, DecisionReason):
+            raise TypeError("reason must be DecisionReason")
+        if not isinstance(self.key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("key must be ExecutionKey")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "purpose", _enum_text(self.purpose, field="purpose"))
+        for field in ("available_cash", "available_quantity", "protective_quantity"):
+            value = getattr(self, field)
+            if value is not None:
+                _decimal(value, field=field)
+
+    @property
+    def authorized(self) -> bool:
+        return self.reason is DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED
+
+    @property
+    def requires_cancel_confirmation(self) -> bool:
+        return self.reason is DecisionReason.REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL
+
+    @property
+    def status(self) -> DecisionReason:
+        """Alias useful to callers that name the typed outcome ``status``."""
+        return self.reason
+
+
+class ReservationLedger:
+    """Account-isolated Decimal cash holds with atomic reserve/release/consume hooks."""
+
+    def __init__(self, available_cash_provider: _AvailableCashProvider) -> None:
+        self._provider = available_cash_provider
+        self._locks: dict[tuple[str, str], asyncio.Lock] = {}
+        self._reservations: dict[str, tuple[CashReservation, Decimal]] = {}
+        self._sequence = 0
+
+    def _lock_for(self, account_scope: tuple[str, str]) -> asyncio.Lock:
+        lock = self._locks.get(account_scope)
+        if lock is None:
+            lock = asyncio.Lock()
+            self._locks[account_scope] = lock
+        return lock
+
+    def _held(self, account_scope: tuple[str, str]) -> Decimal:
+        return sum(
+            (
+                remaining
+                for reservation, remaining in self._reservations.values()
+                if reservation.execution_key.account_scope == account_scope
+            ),
+            start=_ZERO,
+        )
+
+    async def available(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        if not isinstance(key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("key must be ExecutionKey")
+        async with self._lock_for(key.account_scope):
+            return await self._available_locked(key)
+
+    async def _available_locked(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        supplied = await _resolve(self._provider.available_cash(key))
+        base = _decimal(supplied, field="available cash")
+        available = base - self._held(key.account_scope)
+        return max(_ZERO, available)
+
+    async def reserve(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, amount: Decimal
+    ) -> tuple[CashReservation | None, Decimal]:
+        if not isinstance(key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("key must be ExecutionKey")
+        requested = _decimal(amount, field="amount", positive=True)
+        async with self._lock_for(key.account_scope):
+            available = await self._available_locked(key)
+            if requested > available:
+                return None, available
+            self._sequence += 1
+            reservation = CashReservation(f"cash-{self._sequence}", key, requested)
+            self._reservations[reservation.reservation_id] = (reservation, requested)
+            return reservation, available - requested
+
+    async def release(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> Decimal:
+        """Release the exact unconsumed amount and return that released amount."""
+        stored = self._stored(reservation)
+        async with self._lock_for(stored.execution_key.account_scope):
+            stored, remaining = self._pop_checked(reservation)
+            return remaining
+
+    async def consume(self, reservation: CashReservation, amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
+        """Consume part of a hold and return its exact remaining Decimal amount."""
+        consumed = _decimal(amount, field="amount", positive=True)
+        stored = self._stored(reservation)
+        async with self._lock_for(stored.execution_key.account_scope):
+            stored, remaining = self._checked(reservation)
+            if consumed > remaining:
+                raise ValueError("consumed amount exceeds remaining reservation")
+            new_remaining = remaining - consumed
+            if new_remaining == _ZERO:
+                del self._reservations[stored.reservation_id]
+            else:
+                self._reservations[stored.reservation_id] = (stored, new_remaining)
+            return new_remaining
+
+    async def remaining(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> Decimal:
+        stored = self._stored(reservation)
+        async with self._lock_for(stored.execution_key.account_scope):
+            _, remaining = self._checked(reservation)
+            return remaining
+
+    def _stored(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> CashReservation:
+        if not isinstance(reservation, CashReservation):
+            raise TypeError("reservation must be CashReservation")
+        found = self._reservations.get(reservation.reservation_id)
+        if found is None:
+            raise KeyError(f"unknown reservation: {reservation.reservation_id}")
+        return found[0]
+
+    def _checked(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> tuple[CashReservation, Decimal]:
+        found = self._reservations.get(reservation.reservation_id)
+        if found is None or found[0] != reservation:
+            raise KeyError(f"unknown reservation: {reservation.reservation_id}")
+        return found
+
+    def _pop_checked(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> tuple[CashReservation, Decimal]:
+        found = self._checked(reservation)
+        del self._reservations[reservation.reservation_id]
+        return found
+
+
+class OrderCommandCoordinator:
+    """Serialize and authorize commands without performing submission side effects."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        clock: _Clock,
+        quote_age_provider: _QuoteAgeProvider,
+        open_order_provider: _OpenOrderProvider,
+        position_provider: _PositionProvider,
+        buying_power_budget_provider: _AvailableCashProvider,
+        max_quote_age: timedelta,
+        reservation_ledger: ReservationLedger | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(max_quote_age, timedelta) or max_quote_age < timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("max_quote_age must be a non-negative timedelta")
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._quote_age_provider = quote_age_provider
+        self._open_order_provider = open_order_provider
+        self._position_provider = position_provider
+        self._max_quote_age = max_quote_age
+        self._symbol_locks: dict[ExecutionKey, asyncio.Lock] = {}
+        self._unresolved: set[ExecutionKey] = set()
+        self.reservation_ledger = reservation_ledger or ReservationLedger(
+            buying_power_budget_provider
+        )
+
+    def _lock_for(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> asyncio.Lock:
+        lock = self._symbol_locks.get(key)
+        if lock is None:
+            lock = asyncio.Lock()
+            self._symbol_locks[key] = lock
+        return lock
+
+    async def authorize(self, command: OrderCommand) -> CommandDecision:
+        if not isinstance(command, OrderCommand):
+            raise TypeError("command must be OrderCommand")
+        key = command.key
+        purpose = command.purpose
+        async with self._lock_for(key):
+            # Every mutable/checker-backed decision is intentionally made here,
+            # after any earlier command for this exact isolation key completes.
+            now = _aware(self._clock.now(), field="clock.now()")
+            expires_at = _aware(
+                command.intent.signal_expires_at, field="intent.signal_expires_at"
+            )
+            if now >= expires_at:
+                return CommandDecision(DecisionReason.REJECTED_STALE_SIGNAL, key, purpose)
+
+            quote_age = await _resolve(self._quote_age_provider.quote_age(command.intent, now))
+            if not isinstance(quote_age, timedelta):
+                raise TypeError("quote_age provider must return timedelta")
+            if quote_age < timedelta(0) or quote_age > self._max_quote_age:
+                return CommandDecision(DecisionReason.REJECTED_STALE_QUOTE, key, purpose)
+
+            if key in self._unresolved or await _resolve(
+                self._open_order_provider.has_open_or_unresolved_order(key, purpose)
+            ):
+                return CommandDecision(DecisionReason.REJECTED_OPEN_ORDER, key, purpose)
+
+            if purpose == "ENTRY_LONG":
+                reservation, available = await self.reservation_ledger.reserve(
+                    key, command.requested_cash
+                )
+                if reservation is None:
+                    return CommandDecision(
+                        DecisionReason.REJECTED_INSUFFICIENT_CASH,
+                        key,
+                        purpose,
+                        available_cash=available,
+                    )
+                self._unresolved.add(key)
+                return CommandDecision(
+                    DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED,
+                    key,
+                    purpose,
+                    reservation=reservation,
+                    available_cash=available,
+                )
+
+            return await self._authorize_sell_locked(command, key, purpose)
+
+    async def _authorize_sell_locked(
+        self, command: OrderCommand, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> CommandDecision:
+        requested = _decimal(command.intent.qty, field="intent.qty", positive=True)
+        held = _decimal(
+            await _resolve(self._position_provider.confirmed_long_quantity(key)),
+            field="confirmed long quantity",
+        )
+        committed = _decimal(
+            await _resolve(self._position_provider.committed_sell_quantity(key)),
+            field="committed sell quantity",
+        )
+        protective = _decimal(
+            await _resolve(self._position_provider.protective_sell_quantity(key)),
+            field="protective sell quantity",
+        )
+        if protective > committed:
+            raise ValueError("protective sell quantity cannot exceed committed sell quantity")
+
+        available = max(_ZERO, held - committed)
+        if requested <= available:
+            self._unresolved.add(key)
+            return CommandDecision(
+                DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED,
+                key,
+                purpose,
+                available_quantity=available,
+                protective_quantity=protective,
+            )
+
+        available_after_protective_cancel = max(_ZERO, held - (committed - protective))
+        if (
+            command.cancel_protective_first
+            and protective > _ZERO
+            and requested <= available_after_protective_cancel
+        ):
+            self._unresolved.add(key)
+            return CommandDecision(
+                DecisionReason.REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL,
+                key,
+                purpose,
+                available_quantity=available_after_protective_cancel,
+                protective_quantity=protective,
+            )
+
+        return CommandDecision(
+            DecisionReason.REJECTED_OVERSELL,
+            key,
+            purpose,
+            available_quantity=available,
+            protective_quantity=protective,
+        )
+
+    async def release_reservation(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> Decimal:
+        """Abandon an entry authorization and release its remaining cash exactly."""
+        key = reservation.execution_key
+        async with self._lock_for(key):
+            released = await self.reservation_ledger.release(reservation)
+            self._unresolved.discard(key)
+            return released
+
+    async def consume_reservation(
+        self, reservation: CashReservation, amount: Decimal
+    ) -> Decimal:
+        """Fill hook: consume ``amount`` from an entry reservation."""
+        return await self.reservation_ledger.consume(reservation, amount)
+
+    async def complete(self, command: OrderCommand) -> None:
+        """Clear the coordinator's unresolved claim after a terminal order outcome."""
+        if not isinstance(command, OrderCommand):
+            raise TypeError("command must be OrderCommand")
+        async with self._lock_for(command.key):
+            self._unresolved.discard(command.key)

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.execution.coordinator import (
+    DecisionReason,
+    ExecutionKey,
+    OrderCommand,
+    OrderCommandCoordinator,
+)
+
+NOW = datetime(2026, 10, 8, 14, 30, tzinfo=UTC)
+D = Decimal
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Intent:
+    execution_mode: str = "PAPER"
+    account_key: str = "account-1"
+    symbol: str = "AAPL"
+    purpose: str = "ENTRY_LONG"
+    signal_expires_at: datetime = NOW + timedelta(minutes=1)
+    quote_reference_time: datetime = NOW
+    qty: Decimal | None = None
+    notional: Decimal | None = D("60")
+    limit_price: Decimal | None = None
+
+
+class Clock:
+    def __init__(self, now: datetime = NOW) -> None:
+        self.current = now
+
+    def now(self) -> datetime:
+        return self.current
+
+
+class QuoteAges:
+    async def quote_age(self, intent: Intent, now: datetime) -> timedelta:
+        return now - intent.quote_reference_time
+
+
+class NoOpenOrders:
+    async def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool:
+        return False
+
+
+class FirstOpenCheckGate(NoOpenOrders):
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.entered = asyncio.Event()
+        self.release = asyncio.Event()
+        self.calls = 0
+
+    async def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool:
+        self.calls += 1
+        if self.calls == 1:
+            self.entered.set()
+            await self.release.wait()
+        return False
+
+
+class TwoKeyBarrier(NoOpenOrders):
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.arrived = 0
+        self.both_arrived = asyncio.Event()
+        self.release = asyncio.Event()
+
+    async def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool:
+        self.arrived += 1
+        if self.arrived == 2:
+            self.both_arrived.set()
+        await self.release.wait()
+        return False
+
+
+class Positions:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        held: Decimal = D("0"),
+        committed: Decimal = D("0"),
+        protective: Decimal = D("0"),
+    ) -> None:
+        self.held = held
+        self.committed = committed
+        self.protective = protective
+
+    async def confirmed_long_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        return self.held
+
+    async def committed_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        return self.committed
+
+    async def protective_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        return self.protective
+
+
+class Cash:
+    def __init__(self, available: Decimal) -> None:
+        self.amount = available
+
+    async def available_cash(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        return self.amount
+
+
+def coordinator(
+    *,
+    clock: Clock | None = None,
+    open_orders: NoOpenOrders | None = None,
+    positions: Positions | None = None,
+    cash: Cash | None = None,
+    max_quote_age: timedelta = timedelta(seconds=5),
+) -> OrderCommandCoordinator:
+    return OrderCommandCoordinator(
+        clock=clock or Clock(),
+        quote_age_provider=QuoteAges(),
+        open_order_provider=open_orders or NoOpenOrders(),
+        position_provider=positions or Positions(),
+        buying_power_budget_provider=cash or Cash(D("1000")),
+        max_quote_age=max_quote_age,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_same_account_symbol_concurrent_entries_authorize_exactly_one() -> None:
+    gate = FirstOpenCheckGate()
+    subject = coordinator(open_orders=gate)
+    command = OrderCommand(Intent(), reservation_amount=D("10"))
+
+    first = asyncio.create_task(subject.authorize(command))
+    await gate.entered.wait()
+    second = asyncio.create_task(subject.authorize(command))
+    await asyncio.sleep(0)
+    gate.release.set()
+    decisions = await asyncio.gather(first, second)
+
+    assert [decision.reason for decision in decisions].count(DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED) == 1
+    assert [decision.reason for decision in decisions].count(
+        DecisionReason.REJECTED_OPEN_ORDER
+    ) == 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_different_symbols_share_one_account_cash_reservation_section() -> None:
+    subject = coordinator(cash=Cash(D("100")))

+        protective = _decimal(
+            await _resolve(self._position_provider.protective_sell_quantity(key)),
+            field="protective sell quantity",
+        )
+        if protective > committed:
+            raise ValueError("protective sell quantity cannot exceed committed sell quantity")
+
+        available = max(_ZERO, held - committed)
+        if requested <= available:
+            self._unresolved.add(key)
+            return CommandDecision(
+                DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED,
+                key,
+                purpose,
+                available_quantity=available,
+                protective_quantity=protective,
+            )
+
+        available_after_protective_cancel = max(_ZERO, held - (committed - protective))
+        if (
+            command.cancel_protective_first
+            and protective > _ZERO
+            and requested <= available_after_protective_cancel
+        ):
+            self._unresolved.add(key)
+            return CommandDecision(
+                DecisionReason.REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL,
+                key,
+                purpose,
+                available_quantity=available_after_protective_cancel,
+                protective_quantity=protective,
+            )
+
+        return CommandDecision(
+            DecisionReason.REJECTED_OVERSELL,
+            key,
+            purpose,
+            available_quantity=available,
+            protective_quantity=protective,
+        )
+
+    async def release_reservation(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> Decimal:
+        """Abandon an entry authorization and release its remaining cash exactly."""
+        key = reservation.execution_key
+        async with self._lock_for(key):
+            released = await self.reservation_ledger.release(reservation)
+            self._unresolved.discard(key)
+            return released
+
+    async def consume_reservation(
+        self, reservation: CashReservation, amount: Decimal
+    ) -> Decimal:
+        """Fill hook: consume ``amount`` from an entry reservation."""
+        return await self.reservation_ledger.consume(reservation, amount)
+
+    async def complete(self, command: OrderCommand) -> None:
+        """Clear the coordinator's unresolved claim after a terminal order outcome."""
+        if not isinstance(command, OrderCommand):
+            raise TypeError("command must be OrderCommand")
+        async with self._lock_for(command.key):
+            self._unresolved.discard(command.key)

+class QuoteAges:
+    async def quote_age(self, intent: Intent, now: datetime) -> timedelta:

+
+
+class NoOpenOrders:
+    async def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool:
+        return False
+
+
+class FirstOpenCheckGate(NoOpenOrders):
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.entered = asyncio.Event()
+        self.release = asyncio.Event()
+        self.calls = 0
+
+    async def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool:
+        self.calls += 1
+        if self.calls == 1:
+            self.entered.set()
+            await self.release.wait()
+        return False
+
+
+class TwoKeyBarrier(NoOpenOrders):
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.arrived = 0

+
+    async def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool:
+        self.arrived += 1
+        if self.arrived == 2:
+            self.both_arrived.set()
+        await self.release.wait()
+        return False
+
+
+class Positions:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,

+        committed: Decimal = D("0"),
+        protective: Decimal = D("0"),
+    ) -> None:
+        self.held = held
+        self.committed = committed
+        self.protective = protective
+
+    async def confirmed_long_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        return self.held
+
+    async def committed_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        return self.committed
+
+    async def protective_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        return self.protective
+
+
+class Cash:
+    def __init__(self, available: Decimal) -> None:
+        self.amount = available
+
+    async def available_cash(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        return self.amount
+
+
+def coordinator(
+    *,
+    clock: Clock | None = None,
+    open_orders: NoOpenOrders | None = None,
+    positions: Positions | None = None,
+    cash: Cash | None = None,
+    max_quote_age: timedelta = timedelta(seconds=5),
+) -> OrderCommandCoordinator:
+    return OrderCommandCoordinator(
+        clock=clock or Clock(),
+        quote_age_provider=QuoteAges(),
+        open_order_provider=open_orders or NoOpenOrders(),
+        position_provider=positions or Positions(),
+        buying_power_budget_provider=cash or Cash(D("1000")),
+        max_quote_age=max_quote_age,

+"""Serialized, broker-neutral authorization for order-affecting commands.
+
+The coordinator owns only short-lived authorization and cash-reservation state.
+It deliberately does not persist intents, call a broker, or submit orders.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import inspect
+from collections.abc import Awaitable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import Protocol, TypeVar
+
+__all__ = [
+    "OrderCommandCoordinator",
+    "OrderCommand",
+    "CommandDecision",
+    "DecisionReason",
+    "CashReservation",
+    "ReservationLedger",
+    "ExecutionKey",
+]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_T = TypeVar("_T")
+
+
+class _Clock(Protocol):
+    def now(self) -> datetime: ...
+
+
+class _IntentLike(Protocol):
+    execution_mode: object
+    account_key: str
+    symbol: str
+    purpose: object
+    signal_expires_at: datetime
+    quote_reference_time: datetime
+    qty: Decimal | None
+    notional: Decimal | None
+    limit_price: Decimal | None
+
+
+class _QuoteAgeProvider(Protocol):
+    def quote_age(
+        self, intent: _IntentLike, now: datetime
+    ) -> timedelta | Awaitable[timedelta]: ...
+
+
+class _OpenOrderProvider(Protocol):
+    def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool | Awaitable[bool]: ...
+
+
+class _PositionProvider(Protocol):
+    def confirmed_long_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+    def committed_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+    def protective_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+
+class _AvailableCashProvider(Protocol):
+    def available_cash(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+
+async def _resolve(value: _T | Awaitable[_T]) -> _T:
+    if inspect.isawaitable(value):
+        return await value
+    return value
+
+
+def _enum_text(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string or string-valued enum")
+    return raw.strip().upper()
+
+
+def _text(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _decimal(value: object, *, field: str, positive: bool = False) -> Decimal:
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError(f"{field} must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
+    if value < _ZERO or (positive and value == _ZERO):
+        operator = "> 0" if positive else ">= 0"
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be {operator}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _aware(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ExecutionKey:
+    """Strict isolation key for one mode, account/scenario, and symbol."""
+
+    mode: str
+    account_id: str
+    symbol: str
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "mode", _enum_text(self.mode, field="mode"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "account_id", _text(self.account_id, field="account_id"))
+        symbol = _text(self.symbol, field="symbol").upper()
+        if any(character.isspace() for character in symbol):
+            raise ValueError("symbol must not contain whitespace")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_intent(cls, intent: _IntentLike) -> ExecutionKey:
+        return cls(intent.execution_mode, intent.account_key, intent.symbol)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+
+    @property
+    def account_scope(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
+        return (self.mode, self.account_id)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class OrderCommand:
+    """An intent plus coordinator-only reservation/cancellation instructions."""
+
+    intent: _IntentLike
+    reservation_amount: Decimal | None = None
+    cancel_protective_first: bool = False
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        # Structural validation keeps this module independent of f.1's concrete intent.
+        for field in (
+            "execution_mode",
+            "account_key",
+            "symbol",
+            "purpose",
+            "signal_expires_at",
+            "quote_reference_time",
+            "qty",
+            "notional",
+            "limit_price",
+        ):
+            if not hasattr(self.intent, field):
+                raise TypeError(f"intent must provide {field}")
+        if self.reservation_amount is not None:
+            _decimal(self.reservation_amount, field="reservation_amount", positive=True)
+        if not isinstance(self.cancel_protective_first, bool):
+            raise TypeError("cancel_protective_first must be bool")
+
+    @property
+    def key(self) -> ExecutionKey:
+        return ExecutionKey.from_intent(self.intent)
+
+    @property
+    def purpose(self) -> str:
+        return _enum_text(self.intent.purpose, field="purpose")
+
+    @property
+    def requested_cash(self) -> Decimal:
+        if self.reservation_amount is not None:
+            return self.reservation_amount
+        if self.intent.notional is not None:
+            return _decimal(self.intent.notional, field="intent.notional", positive=True)
+        if self.intent.qty is not None and self.intent.limit_price is not None:
+            quantity = _decimal(self.intent.qty, field="intent.qty", positive=True)
+            price = _decimal(self.intent.limit_price, field="intent.limit_price", positive=True)
+            return quantity * price
+        raise ValueError(
+            "ENTRY_LONG requires reservation_amount, notional, or qty with limit_price"
+        )
+
+
+class DecisionReason(Enum):
+    AUTHORIZED = "AUTHORIZED"
+    REJECTED_STALE_SIGNAL = "REJECTED_STALE_SIGNAL"
+    REJECTED_STALE_QUOTE = "REJECTED_STALE_QUOTE"
+    REJECTED_INSUFFICIENT_CASH = "REJECTED_INSUFFICIENT_CASH"
+    REJECTED_OPEN_ORDER = "REJECTED_OPEN_ORDER"
+    REJECTED_OVERSELL = "REJECTED_OVERSELL"
+    REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL = "REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class CashReservation:
+    """Immutable receipt for cash held in a single account-scoped ledger."""
+
+    reservation_id: str
+    execution_key: ExecutionKey
+    amount: Decimal
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "reservation_id", _text(self.reservation_id, field="reservation_id")
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.execution_key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("execution_key must be ExecutionKey")
+        _decimal(self.amount, field="amount", positive=True)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class CommandDecision:
+    reason: DecisionReason
+    key: ExecutionKey
+    purpose: str
+    reservation: CashReservation | None = None
+    available_cash: Decimal | None = None
+    available_quantity: Decimal | None = None
+    protective_quantity: Decimal | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(self.reason, DecisionReason):
+            raise TypeError("reason must be DecisionReason")
+        if not isinstance(self.key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("key must be ExecutionKey")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "purpose", _enum_text(self.purpose, field="purpose"))
+        for field in ("available_cash", "available_quantity", "protective_quantity"):
+            value = getattr(self, field)
+            if value is not None:
+                _decimal(value, field=field)
+
+    @property
+    def authorized(self) -> bool:
+        return self.reason is DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED
+
+    @property
+    def requires_cancel_confirmation(self) -> bool:
+        return self.reason is DecisionReason.REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL
+
+    @property
+    def status(self) -> DecisionReason:
+        """Alias useful to callers that name the typed outcome ``status``."""
+        return self.reason
+
+
+class ReservationLedger:
+    """Account-isolated Decimal cash holds with atomic reserve/release/consume hooks."""
+
+    def __init__(self, available_cash_provider: _AvailableCashProvider) -> None:
+        self._provider = available_cash_provider
+        self._locks: dict[tuple[str, str], asyncio.Lock] = {}
+        self._reservations: dict[str, tuple[CashReservation, Decimal]] = {}
+        self._sequence = 0
+
+    def _lock_for(self, account_scope: tuple[str, str]) -> asyncio.Lock:
+        lock = self._locks.get(account_scope)
+        if lock is None:
+            lock = asyncio.Lock()
+            self._locks[account_scope] = lock
+        return lock
+
+    def _held(self, account_scope: tuple[str, str]) -> Decimal:
+        return sum(
+            (
+                remaining
+                for reservation, remaining in self._reservations.values()
+                if reservation.execution_key.account_scope == account_scope
+            ),
+            start=_ZERO,
+        )
+
+    async def available(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        if not isinstance(key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("key must be ExecutionKey")
+        async with self._lock_for(key.account_scope):
+            return await self._available_locked(key)
+
+    async def _available_locked(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        supplied = await _resolve(self._provider.available_cash(key))
+        base = _decimal(supplied, field="available cash")
+        available = base - self._held(key.account_scope)
+        return max(_ZERO, available)
+
+    async def reserve(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, amount: Decimal
+    ) -> tuple[CashReservation | None, Decimal]:
+        if not isinstance(key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("key must be ExecutionKey")
+        requested = _decimal(amount, field="amount", positive=True)
+        async with self._lock_for(key.account_scope):
+            available = await self._available_locked(key)
+            if requested > available:
+                return None, available
+            self._sequence += 1
+            reservation = CashReservation(f"cash-{self._sequence}", key, requested)
+            self._reservations[reservation.reservation_id] = (reservation, requested)
+            return reservation, available - requested
+
+    async def release(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> Decimal:
+        """Release the exact unconsumed amount and return that released amount."""
+        stored = self._stored(reservation)
+        async with self._lock_for(stored.execution_key.account_scope):
+            stored, remaining = self._pop_checked(reservation)
+            return remaining
+
+    async def consume(self, reservation: CashReservation, amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
+        """Consume part of a hold and return its exact remaining Decimal amount."""
+        consumed = _decimal(amount, field="amount", positive=True)
+        stored = self._stored(reservation)
+        async with self._lock_for(stored.execution_key.account_scope):
+            stored, remaining = self._checked(reservation)
+            if consumed > remaining:
+                raise ValueError("consumed amount exceeds remaining reservation")
+            new_remaining = remaining - consumed
+            if new_remaining == _ZERO:
+                del self._reservations[stored.reservation_id]
+            else:
+                self._reservations[stored.reservation_id] = (stored, new_remaining)
+            return new_remaining
+
+    async def remaining(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> Decimal:
+        stored = self._stored(reservation)
+        async with self._lock_for(stored.execution_key.account_scope):
+            _, remaining = self._checked(reservation)
+            return remaining
+
+    def _stored(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> CashReservation:
+        if not isinstance(reservation, CashReservation):
+            raise TypeError("reservation must be CashReservation")
+        found = self._reservations.get(reservation.reservation_id)
+        if found is None:
+            raise KeyError(f"unknown reservation: {reservation.reservation_id}")
+        return found[0]
+
+    def _checked(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> tuple[CashReservation, Decimal]:
+        found = self._reservations.get(reservation.reservation_id)
+        if found is None or found[0] != reservation:
+            raise KeyError(f"unknown reservation: {reservation.reservation_id}")
+        return found
+
+    def _pop_checked(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> tuple[CashReservation, Decimal]:
+        found = self._checked(reservation)
+        del self._reservations[reservation.reservation_id]
+        return found
+
+
+class OrderCommandCoordinator:
+    """Serialize and authorize commands without performing submission side effects."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        clock: _Clock,
+        quote_age_provider: _QuoteAgeProvider,
+        open_order_provider: _OpenOrderProvider,
+        position_provider: _PositionProvider,
+        buying_power_budget_provider: _AvailableCashProvider,
+        max_quote_age: timedelta,
+        reservation_ledger: ReservationLedger | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(max_quote_age, timedelta) or max_quote_age < timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("max_quote_age must be a non-negative timedelta")
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._quote_age_provider = quote_age_provider
+        self._open_order_provider = open_order_provider
+        self._position_provider = position_provider
+        self._max_quote_age = max_quote_age
+        self._symbol_locks: dict[ExecutionKey, asyncio.Lock] = {}
+        self._unresolved: set[ExecutionKey] = set()
+        self.reservation_ledger = reservation_ledger or ReservationLedger(
+            buying_power_budget_provider
+        )
+
+    def _lock_for(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> asyncio.Lock:
+        lock = self._symbol_locks.get(key)
+        if lock is None:
+            lock = asyncio.Lock()
+            self._symbol_locks[key] = lock
+        return lock
+
+    async def authorize(self, command: OrderCommand) -> CommandDecision:
+        if not isinstance(command, OrderCommand):
+            raise TypeError("command must be OrderCommand")
+        key = command.key
+        purpose = command.purpose
+        async with self._lock_for(key):
+            # Every mutable/checker-backed decision is intentionally made here,
+            # after any earlier command for this exact isolation key completes.
+            now = _aware(self._clock.now(), field="clock.now()")
+            expires_at = _aware(
+                command.intent.signal_expires_at, field="intent.signal_expires_at"
+            )
+            if now >= expires_at:
+                return CommandDecision(DecisionReason.REJECTED_STALE_SIGNAL, key, purpose)
+
+            quote_age = await _resolve(self._quote_age_provider.quote_age(command.intent, now))
+            if not isinstance(quote_age, timedelta):
+                raise TypeError("quote_age provider must return timedelta")
+            if quote_age < timedelta(0) or quote_age > self._max_quote_age:
+                return CommandDecision(DecisionReason.REJECTED_STALE_QUOTE, key, purpose)
+
+            if key in self._unresolved or await _resolve(
+                self._open_order_provider.has_open_or_unresolved_order(key, purpose)
+            ):
+                return CommandDecision(DecisionReason.REJECTED_OPEN_ORDER, key, purpose)
+
+            if purpose == "ENTRY_LONG":
+                reservation, available = await self.reservation_ledger.reserve(
+                    key, command.requested_cash
+                )
+                if reservation is None:
+                    return CommandDecision(
+                        DecisionReason.REJECTED_INSUFFICIENT_CASH,
+                        key,
+                        purpose,
+                        available_cash=available,
+                    )
+                self._unresolved.add(key)
+                return CommandDecision(
+                    DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED,
+                    key,
+                    purpose,
+                    reservation=reservation,
+                    available_cash=available,
+                )
+
+            return await self._authorize_sell_locked(command, key, purpose)
+
+    async def _authorize_sell_locked(
+        self, command: OrderCommand, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> CommandDecision:
+        requested = _decimal(command.intent.qty, field="intent.qty", positive=True)
+        held = _decimal(
+            await _resolve(self._position_provider.confirmed_long_quantity(key)),
+            field="confirmed long quantity",
+        )
+        committed = _decimal(
+            await _resolve(self._position_provider.committed_sell_quantity(key)),
+            field="committed sell quantity",
+        )
+        protective = _decimal(
+            await _resolve(self._position_provider.protective_sell_quantity(key)),
+            field="protective sell quantity",
+        )
+        if protective > committed:
+            raise ValueError("protective sell quantity cannot exceed committed sell quantity")
+
+        available = max(_ZERO, held - committed)
+        if requested <= available:
+            self._unresolved.add(key)
+            return CommandDecision(
+                DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED,
+                key,
+                purpose,
+                available_quantity=available,
+                protective_quantity=protective,
+            )
+
+        available_after_protective_cancel = max(_ZERO, held - (committed - protective))
+        if (
+            command.cancel_protective_first
+            and protective > _ZERO
+            and requested <= available_after_protective_cancel
+        ):
+            self._unresolved.add(key)
+            return CommandDecision(
+                DecisionReason.REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL,
+                key,
+                purpose,
+                available_quantity=available_after_protective_cancel,
+                protective_quantity=protective,
+            )
+
+        return CommandDecision(
+            DecisionReason.REJECTED_OVERSELL,
+            key,
+            purpose,
+            available_quantity=available,
+            protective_quantity=protective,
+        )
+
+    async def release_reservation(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> Decimal:
+        """Abandon an entry authorization and release its remaining cash exactly."""
+        key = reservation.execution_key
+        async with self._lock_for(key):
+            released = await self.reservation_ledger.release(reservation)
+            self._unresolved.discard(key)
+            return released
+
+    async def consume_reservation(
+        self, reservation: CashReservation, amount: Decimal
+    ) -> Decimal:
+        """Fill hook: consume ``amount`` from an entry reservation."""
+        return await self.reservation_ledger.consume(reservation, amount)
+
+    async def complete(self, command: OrderCommand) -> None:
+        """Clear the coordinator's unresolved claim after a terminal order outcome."""
+        if not isinstance(command, OrderCommand):
+            raise TypeError("command must be OrderCommand")
+        async with self._lock_for(command.key):
+            self._unresolved.discard(command.key)

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.execution.coordinator import (
+    DecisionReason,
+    ExecutionKey,
+    OrderCommand,
+    OrderCommandCoordinator,
+)
+
+NOW = datetime(2026, 10, 8, 14, 30, tzinfo=UTC)
+D = Decimal
+ZERO = D("0")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Intent:
+    execution_mode: str = "PAPER"
+    account_key: str = "account-1"
+    symbol: str = "AAPL"
+    purpose: str = "ENTRY_LONG"
+    signal_expires_at: datetime = NOW + timedelta(minutes=1)
+    quote_reference_time: datetime = NOW
+    qty: Decimal | None = None
+    notional: Decimal | None = D("60")
+    limit_price: Decimal | None = None
+
+
+class Clock:
+    def __init__(self, now: datetime = NOW) -> None:
+        self.current = now
+
+    def now(self) -> datetime:
+        return self.current
+
+
+class QuoteAges:
+    async def quote_age(self, intent: Intent, now: datetime) -> timedelta:
+        return now - intent.quote_reference_time
+
+
+class NoOpenOrders:
+    async def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool:
+        return False
+
+
+class FirstOpenCheckGate(NoOpenOrders):
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.entered = asyncio.Event()
+        self.release = asyncio.Event()
+        self.calls = 0
+
+    async def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool:
+        self.calls += 1
+        if self.calls == 1:
+            self.entered.set()
+            await self.release.wait()
+        return False
+
+
+class TwoKeyBarrier(NoOpenOrders):
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.arrived = 0
+        self.both_arrived = asyncio.Event()
+        self.release = asyncio.Event()
+
+    async def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool:
+        self.arrived += 1
+        if self.arrived == 2:
+            self.both_arrived.set()
+        await self.release.wait()
+        return False
+
+
+class Positions:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        held: Decimal = ZERO,
+        committed: Decimal = ZERO,
+        protective: Decimal = ZERO,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.held = held
+        self.committed = committed
+        self.protective = protective
+
+    async def confirmed_long_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        return self.held
+
+    async def committed_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        return self.committed
+
+    async def protective_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        return self.protective
+
+
+class Cash:
+    def __init__(self, available: Decimal) -> None:
+        self.amount = available
+
+    async def available_cash(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        return self.amount
+
+
+def coordinator(
+    *,
+    clock: Clock | None = None,
+    open_orders: NoOpenOrders | None = None,
+    positions: Positions | None = None,
+    cash: Cash | None = None,
+    max_quote_age: timedelta = timedelta(seconds=5),
+) -> OrderCommandCoordinator:
+    return OrderCommandCoordinator(
+        clock=clock or Clock(),
+        quote_age_provider=QuoteAges(),
+        open_order_provider=open_orders or NoOpenOrders(),
+        position_provider=positions or Positions(),
+        buying_power_budget_provider=cash or Cash(D("1000")),
+        max_quote_age=max_quote_age,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_same_account_symbol_concurrent_entries_authorize_exactly_one() -> None:
+    gate = FirstOpenCheckGate()
+    subject = coordinator(open_orders=gate)
+    command = OrderCommand(Intent(), reservation_amount=D("10"))
+
+    first = asyncio.create_task(subject.authorize(command))
+    await gate.entered.wait()
+    second = asyncio.create_task(subject.authorize(command))
+    await asyncio.sleep(0)
+    gate.release.set()
+    decisions = await asyncio.gather(first, second)
+
+    assert [decision.reason for decision in decisions].count(DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED) == 1
+    assert [decision.reason for decision in decisions].count(
+        DecisionReason.REJECTED_OPEN_ORDER
+    ) == 1
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_different_symbols_share_one_account_cash_reservation_section() -> None:
+    subject = coordinator(cash=Cash(D("100")))
+    commands = (
+        OrderCommand(Intent(symbol="AAPL", notional=D("75"))),
+        OrderCommand(Intent(symbol="MSFT", notional=D("75"))),
+    )
+
+    decisions = await asyncio.gather(*(subject.authorize(command) for command in commands))
+
+    assert [decision.reason for decision in decisions].count(DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED) == 1
+    assert [decision.reason for decision in decisions].count(
+        DecisionReason.REJECTED_INSUFFICIENT_CASH
+    ) == 1
+    authorized = next(decision for decision in decisions if decision.authorized)
+    assert authorized.reservation is not None
+    assert authorized.reservation.amount == D("75")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_same_symbol_on_different_accounts_is_fully_independent() -> None:
+    barrier = TwoKeyBarrier()
+    subject = coordinator(open_orders=barrier, cash=Cash(D("60")))
+    commands = (
+        OrderCommand(Intent(account_key="account-a", notional=D("60"))),
+        OrderCommand(Intent(account_key="account-b", notional=D("60"))),
+    )
+
+    tasks = [asyncio.create_task(subject.authorize(command)) for command in commands]
+    await asyncio.wait_for(barrier.both_arrived.wait(), timeout=0.1)
+    barrier.release.set()
+    decisions = await asyncio.gather(*tasks)
+
+    assert all(decision.reason is DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED for decision in decisions)
+    assert decisions[0].key.account_scope != decisions[1].key.account_scope
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_signal_expiry_is_rechecked_after_waiting_for_symbol_lock() -> None:
+    clock = Clock()
+    gate = FirstOpenCheckGate()
+    subject = coordinator(clock=clock, open_orders=gate)
+    first_command = OrderCommand(Intent(notional=D("10")))
+    expiring_command = OrderCommand(
+        Intent(signal_expires_at=NOW + timedelta(seconds=1), notional=D("10"))
+    )
+
+    first = asyncio.create_task(subject.authorize(first_command))
+    await gate.entered.wait()
+    waiting = asyncio.create_task(subject.authorize(expiring_command))
+    await asyncio.sleep(0)
+    clock.current = NOW + timedelta(seconds=2)
+    gate.release.set()
+    first_decision, waiting_decision = await asyncio.gather(first, waiting)
+
+    assert first_decision.reason is DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED
+    assert waiting_decision.reason is DecisionReason.REJECTED_STALE_SIGNAL
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_quote_freshness_is_rechecked_after_waiting_for_symbol_lock() -> None:
+    clock = Clock()
+    gate = FirstOpenCheckGate()
+    subject = coordinator(
+        clock=clock,
+        open_orders=gate,
+        max_quote_age=timedelta(seconds=1),
+    )
+    command = OrderCommand(Intent(notional=D("10")))
+
+    first = asyncio.create_task(subject.authorize(command))
+    await gate.entered.wait()
+    waiting = asyncio.create_task(subject.authorize(command))
+    await asyncio.sleep(0)
+    clock.current = NOW + timedelta(seconds=2)
+    gate.release.set()
+    first_decision, waiting_decision = await asyncio.gather(first, waiting)
+
+    assert first_decision.reason is DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED
+    assert waiting_decision.reason is DecisionReason.REJECTED_STALE_QUOTE
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_exit_cannot_exceed_confirmed_quantity_less_working_sells() -> None:
+    subject = coordinator(positions=Positions(held=D("10"), committed=D("3")))
+    command = OrderCommand(
+        Intent(purpose="EXIT_LONG", qty=D("8"), notional=None),
+    )
+
+    decision = await subject.authorize(command)
+
+    assert decision.reason is DecisionReason.REJECTED_OVERSELL
+    assert decision.available_quantity == D("7")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_exit_conflicting_with_protective_stop_requires_cancel_confirmation() -> None:
+    subject = coordinator(
+        positions=Positions(held=D("10"), committed=D("10"), protective=D("10"))
+    )
+    command = OrderCommand(
+        Intent(purpose="MANUAL_CLOSE", qty=D("10"), notional=None),
+        cancel_protective_first=True,
+    )
+
+    decision = await subject.authorize(command)
+
+    assert decision.reason is DecisionReason.REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL
+    assert decision.requires_cancel_confirmation
+    assert not decision.authorized
+    assert decision.protective_quantity == D("10")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_decimal_reservation_consume_and_release_restore_cash_exactly() -> None:
+    subject = coordinator(cash=Cash(D("100.10")))
+    command = OrderCommand(Intent(notional=D("33.33")))
+    key = command.key
+    before = await subject.reservation_ledger.available(key)
+    decision = await subject.authorize(command)
+    assert decision.reservation is not None
+
+    after_reserve = await subject.reservation_ledger.available(key)
+    remaining = await subject.consume_reservation(decision.reservation, D("3.33"))
+    released = await subject.release_reservation(decision.reservation)
+    after_release = await subject.reservation_ledger.available(key)
+
+    assert before == D("100.10")
+    assert after_reserve == D("66.77")
+    assert remaining == D("30.00")
+    assert released == D("30.00")
+    assert after_release == before
+    assert all(isinstance(value, Decimal) for value in (before, remaining, released))
+    with pytest.raises(TypeError, match="must be Decimal"):
+        await subject.reservation_ledger.reserve(key, 1.0)  # type: ignore[arg-type]

+"""Serialized, broker-neutral authorization for order-affecting commands.
+
+The coordinator owns only short-lived authorization and cash-reservation state.
+It deliberately does not persist intents, call a broker, or submit orders.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import inspect
+from collections.abc import Awaitable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import Protocol, TypeVar
+
+__all__ = [
+    "OrderCommandCoordinator",
+    "OrderCommand",
+    "CommandDecision",
+    "DecisionReason",
+    "CashReservation",
+    "ReservationLedger",
+    "ExecutionKey",
+]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_T = TypeVar("_T")
+
+
+class _Clock(Protocol):
+    def now(self) -> datetime: ...
+
+
+class _IntentLike(Protocol):
+    execution_mode: object
+    account_key: str
+    symbol: str
+    purpose: object
+    signal_expires_at: datetime
+    quote_reference_time: datetime
+    qty: Decimal | None
+    notional: Decimal | None
+    limit_price: Decimal | None
+
+
+class _QuoteAgeProvider(Protocol):
+    def quote_age(
+        self, intent: _IntentLike, now: datetime
+    ) -> timedelta | Awaitable[timedelta]: ...
+
+
+class _OpenOrderProvider(Protocol):
+    def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool | Awaitable[bool]: ...
+
+
+class _PositionProvider(Protocol):
+    def confirmed_long_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+    def committed_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+    def protective_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+
+class _AvailableCashProvider(Protocol):
+    def available_cash(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+
+async def _resolve(value: _T | Awaitable[_T]) -> _T:
+    if inspect.isawaitable(value):
+        return await value
+    return value
+
+
+def _enum_text(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string or string-valued enum")
+    return raw.strip().upper()
+
+
+def _text(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _decimal(value: object, *, field: str, positive: bool = False) -> Decimal:
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError(f"{field} must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
+    if value < _ZERO or (positive and value == _ZERO):
+        operator = "> 0" if positive else ">= 0"
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be {operator}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _aware(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ExecutionKey:
+    """Strict isolation key for one mode, account/scenario, and symbol."""
+
+    mode: str
+    account_id: str
+    symbol: str
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "mode", _enum_text(self.mode, field="mode"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "account_id", _text(self.account_id, field="account_id"))
+        symbol = _text(self.symbol, field="symbol").upper()
+        if any(character.isspace() for character in symbol):
+            raise ValueError("symbol must not contain whitespace")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_intent(cls, intent: _IntentLike) -> ExecutionKey:
+        return cls(intent.execution_mode, intent.account_key, intent.symbol)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+
+    @property
+    def account_scope(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
+        return (self.mode, self.account_id)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class OrderCommand:
+    """An intent plus coordinator-only reservation/cancellation instructions."""
+
+    intent: _IntentLike
+    reservation_amount: Decimal | None = None
+    cancel_protective_first: bool = False
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        # Structural validation keeps this module independent of f.1's concrete intent.
+        for field in (
+            "execution_mode",
+            "account_key",
+            "symbol",
+            "purpose",
+            "signal_expires_at",
+            "quote_reference_time",
+            "qty",
+            "notional",
+            "limit_price",
+        ):
+            if not hasattr(self.intent, field):
+                raise TypeError(f"intent must provide {field}")
+        if self.reservation_amount is not None:
+            _decimal(self.reservation_amount, field="reservation_amount", positive=True)
+        if not isinstance(self.cancel_protective_first, bool):
+            raise TypeError("cancel_protective_first must be bool")
+
+    @property
+    def key(self) -> ExecutionKey:
+        return ExecutionKey.from_intent(self.intent)
+
+    @property
+    def purpose(self) -> str:
+        return _enum_text(self.intent.purpose, field="purpose")
+
+    @property
+    def requested_cash(self) -> Decimal:
+        if self.reservation_amount is not None:
+            return self.reservation_amount
+        if self.intent.notional is not None:
+            return _decimal(self.intent.notional, field="intent.notional", positive=True)
+        if self.intent.qty is not None and self.intent.limit_price is not None:
+            quantity = _decimal(self.intent.qty, field="intent.qty", positive=True)
+            price = _decimal(self.intent.limit_price, field="intent.limit_price", positive=True)
+            return quantity * price
+        raise ValueError(
+            "ENTRY_LONG requires reservation_amount, notional, or qty with limit_price"
+        )
+
+
+class DecisionReason(Enum):
+    AUTHORIZED = "AUTHORIZED"
+    REJECTED_STALE_SIGNAL = "REJECTED_STALE_SIGNAL"
+    REJECTED_STALE_QUOTE = "REJECTED_STALE_QUOTE"
+    REJECTED_INSUFFICIENT_CASH = "REJECTED_INSUFFICIENT_CASH"
+    REJECTED_OPEN_ORDER = "REJECTED_OPEN_ORDER"
+    REJECTED_OVERSELL = "REJECTED_OVERSELL"
+    REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL = "REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class CashReservation:
+    """Immutable receipt for cash held in a single account-scoped ledger."""
+
+    reservation_id: str
+    execution_key: ExecutionKey
+    amount: Decimal
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "reservation_id", _text(self.reservation_id, field="reservation_id")
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.execution_key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("execution_key must be ExecutionKey")
+        _decimal(self.amount, field="amount", positive=True)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class CommandDecision:
+    reason: DecisionReason
+    key: ExecutionKey
+    purpose: str
+    reservation: CashReservation | None = None
+    available_cash: Decimal | None = None
+    available_quantity: Decimal | None = None
+    protective_quantity: Decimal | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(self.reason, DecisionReason):
+            raise TypeError("reason must be DecisionReason")
+        if not isinstance(self.key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("key must be ExecutionKey")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "purpose", _enum_text(self.purpose, field="purpose"))
+        for field in ("available_cash", "available_quantity", "protective_quantity"):
+            value = getattr(self, field)
+            if value is not None:
+                _decimal(value, field=field)
+
+    @property
+    def authorized(self) -> bool:
+        return self.reason is DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED
+
+    @property
+    def requires_cancel_confirmation(self) -> bool:
+        return self.reason is DecisionReason.REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL
+
+    @property
+    def status(self) -> DecisionReason:
+        """Alias useful to callers that name the typed outcome ``status``."""
+        return self.reason
+
+
+class ReservationLedger:
+    """Account-isolated Decimal cash holds with atomic reserve/release/consume hooks."""
+
+    def __init__(self, available_cash_provider: _AvailableCashProvider) -> None:
+        self._provider = available_cash_provider
+        self._locks: dict[tuple[str, str], asyncio.Lock] = {}
+        self._reservations: dict[str, tuple[CashReservation, Decimal]] = {}
+        self._sequence = 0
+
+    def _lock_for(self, account_scope: tuple[str, str]) -> asyncio.Lock:
+        lock = self._locks.get(account_scope)
+        if lock is None:
+            lock = asyncio.Lock()
+            self._locks[account_scope] = lock
+        return lock
+
+    def _held(self, account_scope: tuple[str, str]) -> Decimal:
+        return sum(
+            (
+                remaining
+                for reservation, remaining in self._reservations.values()
+                if reservation.execution_key.account_scope == account_scope
+            ),
+            start=_ZERO,
+        )
+
+    async def available(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        if not isinstance(key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("key must be ExecutionKey")
+        async with self._lock_for(key.account_scope):
+            return await self._available_locked(key)
+
+    async def _available_locked(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        supplied = await _resolve(self._provider.available_cash(key))
+        base = _decimal(supplied, field="available cash")
+        available = base - self._held(key.account_scope)
+        return max(_ZERO, available)
+
+    async def reserve(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, amount: Decimal
+    ) -> tuple[CashReservation | None, Decimal]:
+        if not isinstance(key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("key must be ExecutionKey")
+        requested = _decimal(amount, field="amount", positive=True)
+        async with self._lock_for(key.account_scope):
+            available = await self._available_locked(key)
+            if requested > available:
+                return None, available
+            self._sequence += 1
+            reservation = CashReservation(f"cash-{self._sequence}", key, requested)
+            self._reservations[reservation.reservation_id] = (reservation, requested)
+            return reservation, available - requested
+
+    async def release(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> Decimal:
+        """Release the exact unconsumed amount and return that released amount."""
+        stored = self._stored(reservation)
+        async with self._lock_for(stored.execution_key.account_scope):
+            stored, remaining = self._pop_checked(reservation)
+            return remaining
+
+    async def consume(self, reservation: CashReservation, amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
+        """Consume part of a hold and return its exact remaining Decimal amount."""
+        consumed = _decimal(amount, field="amount", positive=True)
+        stored = self._stored(reservation)
+        async with self._lock_for(stored.execution_key.account_scope):
+            stored, remaining = self._checked(reservation)
+            if consumed > remaining:
+                raise ValueError("consumed amount exceeds remaining reservation")
+            new_remaining = remaining - consumed
+            if new_remaining == _ZERO:
+                del self._reservations[stored.reservation_id]
+            else:
+                self._reservations[stored.reservation_id] = (stored, new_remaining)
+            return new_remaining
+
+    async def remaining(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> Decimal:
+        stored = self._stored(reservation)
+        async with self._lock_for(stored.execution_key.account_scope):
+            _, remaining = self._checked(reservation)
+            return remaining
+
+    def _stored(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> CashReservation:
+        if not isinstance(reservation, CashReservation):
+            raise TypeError("reservation must be CashReservation")
+        found = self._reservations.get(reservation.reservation_id)
+        if found is None:
+            raise KeyError(f"unknown reservation: {reservation.reservation_id}")
+        return found[0]
+
+    def _checked(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> tuple[CashReservation, Decimal]:
+        found = self._reservations.get(reservation.reservation_id)
+        if found is None or found[0] != reservation:
+            raise KeyError(f"unknown reservation: {reservation.reservation_id}")
+        return found
+
+    def _pop_checked(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> tuple[CashReservation, Decimal]:
+        found = self._checked(reservation)
+        del self._reservations[reservation.reservation_id]
+        return found
+
+
+class OrderCommandCoordinator:
+    """Serialize and authorize commands without performing submission side effects."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        clock: _Clock,
+        quote_age_provider: _QuoteAgeProvider,
+        open_order_provider: _OpenOrderProvider,
+        position_provider: _PositionProvider,
+        buying_power_budget_provider: _AvailableCashProvider,
+        max_quote_age: timedelta,
+        reservation_ledger: ReservationLedger | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(max_quote_age, timedelta) or max_quote_age < timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("max_quote_age must be a non-negative timedelta")
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._quote_age_provider = quote_age_provider
+        self._open_order_provider = open_order_provider
+        self._position_provider = position_provider
+        self._max_quote_age = max_quote_age
+        self._symbol_locks: dict[ExecutionKey, asyncio.Lock] = {}
+        self._unresolved: set[ExecutionKey] = set()
+        self.reservation_ledger = reservation_ledger or ReservationLedger(
+            buying_power_budget_provider
+        )
+
+    def _lock_for(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> asyncio.Lock:
+        lock = self._symbol_locks.get(key)
+        if lock is None:
+            lock = asyncio.Lock()
+            self._symbol_locks[key] = lock
+        return lock
+
+    async def authorize(self, command: OrderCommand) -> CommandDecision:
+        if not isinstance(command, OrderCommand):
+            raise TypeError("command must be OrderCommand")
+        key = command.key
+        purpose = command.purpose
+        async with self._lock_for(key):
+            # Every mutable/checker-backed decision is intentionally made here,
+            # after any earlier command for this exact isolation key completes.
+            now = _aware(self._clock.now(), field="clock.now()")
+            expires_at = _aware(
+                command.intent.signal_expires_at, field="intent.signal_expires_at"
+            )
+            if now >= expires_at:
+                return CommandDecision(DecisionReason.REJECTED_STALE_SIGNAL, key, purpose)
+
+            quote_age = await _resolve(self._quote_age_provider.quote_age(command.intent, now))
+            if not isinstance(quote_age, timedelta):
+                raise TypeError("quote_age provider must return timedelta")
+            if quote_age < timedelta(0) or quote_age > self._max_quote_age:
+                return CommandDecision(DecisionReason.REJECTED_STALE_QUOTE, key, purpose)
+
+            if key in self._unresolved or await _resolve(
+                self._open_order_provider.has_open_or_unresolved_order(key, purpose)
+            ):
+                return CommandDecision(DecisionReason.REJECTED_OPEN_ORDER, key, purpose)
+
+            if purpose == "ENTRY_LONG":
+                reservation, available = await self.reservation_ledger.reserve(
+                    key, command.requested_cash
+                )
+                if reservation is None:
+                    return CommandDecision(
+                        DecisionReason.REJECTED_INSUFFICIENT_CASH,
+                        key,
+                        purpose,
+                        available_cash=available,
+                    )
+                self._unresolved.add(key)
+                return CommandDecision(
+                    DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED,
+                    key,
+                    purpose,
+                    reservation=reservation,
+                    available_cash=available,
+                )
+
+            return await self._authorize_sell_locked(command, key, purpose)
+
+    async def _authorize_sell_locked(
+        self, command: OrderCommand, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> CommandDecision:
+        requested = _decimal(command.intent.qty, field="intent.qty", positive=True)
+        held = _decimal(
+            await _resolve(self._position_provider.confirmed_long_quantity(key)),
+            field="confirmed long quantity",
+        )
+        committed = _decimal(
+            await _resolve(self._position_provider.committed_sell_quantity(key)),
+            field="committed sell quantity",
+        )
+        protective = _decimal(
+            await _resolve(self._position_provider.protective_sell_quantity(key)),
+            field="protective sell quantity",
+        )
+        if protective > committed:
+            raise ValueError("protective sell quantity cannot exceed committed sell quantity")
+
+        available = max(_ZERO, held - committed)
+        if requested <= available:
+            self._unresolved.add(key)
+            return CommandDecision(
+                DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED,
+                key,
+                purpose,
+                available_quantity=available,
+                protective_quantity=protective,
+            )
+
+        available_after_protective_cancel = max(_ZERO, held - (committed - protective))
+        if (
+            command.cancel_protective_first
+            and protective > _ZERO
+            and requested <= available_after_protective_cancel
+        ):
+            self._unresolved.add(key)
+            return CommandDecision(
+                DecisionReason.REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL,
+                key,
+                purpose,
+                available_quantity=available_after_protective_cancel,
+                protective_quantity=protective,
+            )
+
+        return CommandDecision(
+            DecisionReason.REJECTED_OVERSELL,
+            key,
+            purpose,
+            available_quantity=available,
+            protective_quantity=protective,
+        )
+
+    async def release_reservation(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> Decimal:
+        """Abandon an entry authorization and release its remaining cash exactly."""
+        key = reservation.execution_key
+        async with self._lock_for(key):
+            released = await self.reservation_ledger.release(reservation)
+            self._unresolved.discard(key)
+            return released
+
+    async def consume_reservation(
+        self, reservation: CashReservation, amount: Decimal
+    ) -> Decimal:
+        """Fill hook: consume ``amount`` from an entry reservation."""
+        return await self.reservation_ledger.consume(reservation, amount)
+
+    async def complete(self, command: OrderCommand) -> None:
+        """Clear the coordinator's unresolved claim after a terminal order outcome."""
+        if not isinstance(command, OrderCommand):
+            raise TypeError("command must be OrderCommand")
+        async with self._lock_for(command.key):
+            self._unresolved.discard(command.key)

+from __future__ import annotations

+import asyncio
