+"""Serialized, broker-neutral authorization for order-affecting commands.
+
+The coordinator owns only short-lived authorization and cash-reservation state.
+It deliberately does not persist intents, call a broker, or submit orders.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import inspect
+from collections.abc import Awaitable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import Protocol, TypeVar
+
+__all__ = [
+    "OrderCommandCoordinator",
+    "OrderCommand",
+    "CommandDecision",
+    "DecisionReason",
+    "CashReservation",
+    "ReservationLedger",
+    "ExecutionKey",
+]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_T = TypeVar("_T")
+
+
+class _Clock(Protocol):
+    def now(self) -> datetime: ...
+
+
+class _IntentLike(Protocol):
+    @property
+    def execution_mode(self) -> str | Enum: ...
+
+    @property
+    def account_key(self) -> str: ...
+
+    @property
+    def symbol(self) -> str: ...
+
+    @property
+    def purpose(self) -> str | Enum: ...
+
+    @property
+    def signal_expires_at(self) -> datetime: ...
+
+    @property
+    def quote_reference_time(self) -> datetime: ...
+
+    @property
+    def qty(self) -> Decimal | None: ...
+
+    @property
+    def notional(self) -> Decimal | None: ...
+
+    @property
+    def limit_price(self) -> Decimal | None: ...
+
+
+class _QuoteAgeProvider(Protocol):
+    def quote_age(
+        self, intent: _IntentLike, now: datetime
+    ) -> timedelta | Awaitable[timedelta]: ...
+
+
+class _OpenOrderProvider(Protocol):
+    def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool | Awaitable[bool]: ...
+
+
+class _PositionProvider(Protocol):
+    def confirmed_long_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+    def committed_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+    def protective_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+
+class _AvailableCashProvider(Protocol):
+    def available_cash(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+
+async def _resolve(value: _T | Awaitable[_T]) -> _T:
+    if inspect.isawaitable(value):
+        return await value
+    return value
+
+
+def _enum_text(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string or string-valued enum")
+    return raw.strip().upper()
+
+
+def _text(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _decimal(value: object, *, field: str, positive: bool = False) -> Decimal:
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError(f"{field} must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
+    if value < _ZERO or (positive and value == _ZERO):
+        operator = "> 0" if positive else ">= 0"
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be {operator}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _aware(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ExecutionKey:
+    """Strict isolation key for one mode, account/scenario, and symbol."""
+
+    mode: str | Enum
+    account_id: str
+    symbol: str
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "mode", _enum_text(self.mode, field="mode"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "account_id", _text(self.account_id, field="account_id"))
+        symbol = _text(self.symbol, field="symbol").upper()
+        if any(character.isspace() for character in symbol):
+            raise ValueError("symbol must not contain whitespace")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_intent(cls, intent: _IntentLike) -> ExecutionKey:
+        return cls(intent.execution_mode, intent.account_key, intent.symbol)
+
+    @property
+    def account_scope(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
+        return (_enum_text(self.mode, field="mode"), self.account_id)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class OrderCommand:
+    """An intent plus coordinator-only reservation/cancellation instructions."""
+
+    intent: _IntentLike
+    reservation_amount: Decimal | None = None
+    cancel_protective_first: bool = False
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        # Structural validation keeps this module independent of f.1's concrete intent.
+        for field in (
+            "execution_mode",
+            "account_key",
+            "symbol",
+            "purpose",
+            "signal_expires_at",
+            "quote_reference_time",
+            "qty",
+            "notional",
+            "limit_price",
+        ):
+            if not hasattr(self.intent, field):
+                raise TypeError(f"intent must provide {field}")
+        if self.reservation_amount is not None:
+            _decimal(self.reservation_amount, field="reservation_amount", positive=True)
+        if not isinstance(self.cancel_protective_first, bool):
+            raise TypeError("cancel_protective_first must be bool")
+
+    @property
+    def key(self) -> ExecutionKey:
+        return ExecutionKey.from_intent(self.intent)
+
+    @property
+    def purpose(self) -> str:
+        return _enum_text(self.intent.purpose, field="purpose")
+
+    @property
+    def requested_cash(self) -> Decimal:
+        if self.reservation_amount is not None:
+            return self.reservation_amount
+        if self.intent.notional is not None:
+            return _decimal(self.intent.notional, field="intent.notional", positive=True)
+        if self.intent.qty is not None and self.intent.limit_price is not None:
+            quantity = _decimal(self.intent.qty, field="intent.qty", positive=True)
+            price = _decimal(self.intent.limit_price, field="intent.limit_price", positive=True)
+            return quantity * price
+        raise ValueError(
+            "ENTRY_LONG requires reservation_amount, notional, or qty with limit_price"
+        )
+
+
+class DecisionReason(Enum):
+    AUTHORIZED = "AUTHORIZED"
+    REJECTED_STALE_SIGNAL = "REJECTED_STALE_SIGNAL"
+    REJECTED_STALE_QUOTE = "REJECTED_STALE_QUOTE"
+    REJECTED_INSUFFICIENT_CASH = "REJECTED_INSUFFICIENT_CASH"
+    REJECTED_OPEN_ORDER = "REJECTED_OPEN_ORDER"
+    REJECTED_OVERSELL = "REJECTED_OVERSELL"
+    REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL = "REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class CashReservation:
+    """Immutable receipt for cash held in a single account-scoped ledger."""
+
+    reservation_id: str
+    execution_key: ExecutionKey
+    amount: Decimal
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(
+            self, "reservation_id", _text(self.reservation_id, field="reservation_id")
+        )
+        if not isinstance(self.execution_key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("execution_key must be ExecutionKey")
+        _decimal(self.amount, field="amount", positive=True)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class CommandDecision:
+    reason: DecisionReason
+    key: ExecutionKey
+    purpose: str
+    reservation: CashReservation | None = None
+    available_cash: Decimal | None = None
+    available_quantity: Decimal | None = None
+    protective_quantity: Decimal | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(self.reason, DecisionReason):
+            raise TypeError("reason must be DecisionReason")
+        if not isinstance(self.key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("key must be ExecutionKey")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "purpose", _enum_text(self.purpose, field="purpose"))
+        for field in ("available_cash", "available_quantity", "protective_quantity"):
+            value = getattr(self, field)
+            if value is not None:
+                _decimal(value, field=field)
+
+    @property
+    def authorized(self) -> bool:
+        return self.reason is DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED
+
+    @property
+    def requires_cancel_confirmation(self) -> bool:
+        return self.reason is DecisionReason.REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL
+
+    @property
+    def status(self) -> DecisionReason:
+        """Alias useful to callers that name the typed outcome ``status``."""
+        return self.reason
+
+
+class ReservationLedger:
+    """Account-isolated Decimal cash holds with atomic reserve/release/consume hooks."""
+
+    def __init__(self, available_cash_provider: _AvailableCashProvider) -> None:
+        self._provider = available_cash_provider
+        self._locks: dict[tuple[str, str], asyncio.Lock] = {}
+        self._reservations: dict[str, tuple[CashReservation, Decimal]] = {}
+        self._sequence = 0
+
+    def _lock_for(self, account_scope: tuple[str, str]) -> asyncio.Lock:
+        lock = self._locks.get(account_scope)
+        if lock is None:
+            lock = asyncio.Lock()
+            self._locks[account_scope] = lock
+        return lock
+
+    def _held(self, account_scope: tuple[str, str]) -> Decimal:
+        return sum(
+            (
+                remaining
+                for reservation, remaining in self._reservations.values()
+                if reservation.execution_key.account_scope == account_scope
+            ),
+            start=_ZERO,
+        )
+
+    async def available(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        if not isinstance(key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("key must be ExecutionKey")
+        async with self._lock_for(key.account_scope):
+            return await self._available_locked(key)
+
+    async def _available_locked(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        supplied = await _resolve(self._provider.available_cash(key))
+        base = _decimal(supplied, field="available cash")
+        available = base - self._held(key.account_scope)
+        return max(_ZERO, available)
+
+    async def reserve(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, amount: Decimal
+    ) -> tuple[CashReservation | None, Decimal]:
+        if not isinstance(key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("key must be ExecutionKey")
+        requested = _decimal(amount, field="amount", positive=True)
+        async with self._lock_for(key.account_scope):
+            available = await self._available_locked(key)
+            if requested > available:
+                return None, available
+            self._sequence += 1
+            reservation = CashReservation(f"cash-{self._sequence}", key, requested)
+            self._reservations[reservation.reservation_id] = (reservation, requested)
+            return reservation, available - requested
+
+    async def release(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> Decimal:
+        """Release the exact unconsumed amount and return that released amount."""
+        stored = self._stored(reservation)
+        async with self._lock_for(stored.execution_key.account_scope):
+            stored, remaining = self._pop_checked(reservation)
+            return remaining
+
+    async def consume(self, reservation: CashReservation, amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
+        """Consume part of a hold and return its exact remaining Decimal amount."""
+        consumed = _decimal(amount, field="amount", positive=True)
+        stored = self._stored(reservation)
+        async with self._lock_for(stored.execution_key.account_scope):
+            stored, remaining = self._checked(reservation)
+            if consumed > remaining:
+                raise ValueError("consumed amount exceeds remaining reservation")
+            new_remaining = remaining - consumed
+            if new_remaining == _ZERO:
+                del self._reservations[stored.reservation_id]
+            else:
+                self._reservations[stored.reservation_id] = (stored, new_remaining)
+            return new_remaining
+
+    async def remaining(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> Decimal:
+        stored = self._stored(reservation)
+        async with self._lock_for(stored.execution_key.account_scope):
+            _, remaining = self._checked(reservation)
+            return remaining
+
+    def _stored(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> CashReservation:
+        if not isinstance(reservation, CashReservation):
+            raise TypeError("reservation must be CashReservation")
+        found = self._reservations.get(reservation.reservation_id)
+        if found is None:
+            raise KeyError(f"unknown reservation: {reservation.reservation_id}")
+        return found[0]
+
+    def _checked(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> tuple[CashReservation, Decimal]:
+        found = self._reservations.get(reservation.reservation_id)
+        if found is None or found[0] != reservation:
+            raise KeyError(f"unknown reservation: {reservation.reservation_id}")
+        return found
+
+    def _pop_checked(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> tuple[CashReservation, Decimal]:
+        found = self._checked(reservation)
+        del self._reservations[reservation.reservation_id]
+        return found
+
+
+class OrderCommandCoordinator:
+    """Serialize and authorize commands without performing submission side effects."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        clock: _Clock,
+        quote_age_provider: _QuoteAgeProvider,
+        open_order_provider: _OpenOrderProvider,
+        position_provider: _PositionProvider,
+        buying_power_budget_provider: _AvailableCashProvider,
+        max_quote_age: timedelta,
+        reservation_ledger: ReservationLedger | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(max_quote_age, timedelta) or max_quote_age < timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("max_quote_age must be a non-negative timedelta")
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._quote_age_provider = quote_age_provider
+        self._open_order_provider = open_order_provider
+        self._position_provider = position_provider
+        self._max_quote_age = max_quote_age
+        self._symbol_locks: dict[ExecutionKey, asyncio.Lock] = {}
+        self._unresolved: set[ExecutionKey] = set()
+        self.reservation_ledger = reservation_ledger or ReservationLedger(
+            buying_power_budget_provider
+        )
+
+    def _lock_for(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> asyncio.Lock:
+        lock = self._symbol_locks.get(key)
+        if lock is None:
+            lock = asyncio.Lock()
+            self._symbol_locks[key] = lock
+        return lock
+
+    async def authorize(self, command: OrderCommand) -> CommandDecision:
+        if not isinstance(command, OrderCommand):
+            raise TypeError("command must be OrderCommand")
+        key = command.key
+        purpose = command.purpose
+        async with self._lock_for(key):
+            # Every mutable/checker-backed decision is intentionally made here,
+            # after any earlier command for this exact isolation key completes.
+            now = _aware(self._clock.now(), field="clock.now()")
+            expires_at = _aware(
+                command.intent.signal_expires_at, field="intent.signal_expires_at"
+            )
+            if now >= expires_at:
+                return CommandDecision(DecisionReason.REJECTED_STALE_SIGNAL, key, purpose)
+
+            quote_age = await _resolve(self._quote_age_provider.quote_age(command.intent, now))
+            if not isinstance(quote_age, timedelta):
+                raise TypeError("quote_age provider must return timedelta")
+            if quote_age < timedelta(0) or quote_age > self._max_quote_age:
+                return CommandDecision(DecisionReason.REJECTED_STALE_QUOTE, key, purpose)
+
+            if key in self._unresolved or await _resolve(
+                self._open_order_provider.has_open_or_unresolved_order(key, purpose)
+            ):
+                return CommandDecision(DecisionReason.REJECTED_OPEN_ORDER, key, purpose)
+
+            if purpose == "ENTRY_LONG":
+                reservation, available = await self.reservation_ledger.reserve(
+                    key, command.requested_cash
+                )
+                if reservation is None:
+                    return CommandDecision(
+                        DecisionReason.REJECTED_INSUFFICIENT_CASH,
+                        key,
+                        purpose,
+                        available_cash=available,
+                    )
+                self._unresolved.add(key)
+                return CommandDecision(
+                    DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED,
+                    key,
+                    purpose,
+                    reservation=reservation,
+                    available_cash=available,
+                )
+
+            return await self._authorize_sell_locked(command, key, purpose)
+
+    async def _authorize_sell_locked(
+        self, command: OrderCommand, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> CommandDecision:
+        requested = _decimal(command.intent.qty, field="intent.qty", positive=True)
+        held = _decimal(
+            await _resolve(self._position_provider.confirmed_long_quantity(key)),
+            field="confirmed long quantity",
+        )
+        committed = _decimal(
+            await _resolve(self._position_provider.committed_sell_quantity(key)),
+            field="committed sell quantity",
+        )
+        protective = _decimal(
+            await _resolve(self._position_provider.protective_sell_quantity(key)),
+            field="protective sell quantity",
+        )
+        if protective > committed:
+            raise ValueError("protective sell quantity cannot exceed committed sell quantity")
+
+        available = max(_ZERO, held - committed)
+        if requested <= available:
+            self._unresolved.add(key)
+            return CommandDecision(
+                DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED,
+                key,
+                purpose,
+                available_quantity=available,
+                protective_quantity=protective,
+            )
+
+        available_after_protective_cancel = max(_ZERO, held - (committed - protective))
+        if (
+            command.cancel_protective_first
+            and protective > _ZERO
+            and requested <= available_after_protective_cancel
+        ):
+            self._unresolved.add(key)
+            return CommandDecision(
+                DecisionReason.REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL,
+                key,
+                purpose,
+                available_quantity=available_after_protective_cancel,
+                protective_quantity=protective,
+            )
+
+        return CommandDecision(
+            DecisionReason.REJECTED_OVERSELL,
+            key,
+            purpose,
+            available_quantity=available,
+            protective_quantity=protective,
+        )
+
+    async def release_reservation(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> Decimal:
+        """Abandon an entry authorization and release its remaining cash exactly."""
+        key = reservation.execution_key
+        async with self._lock_for(key):
+            released = await self.reservation_ledger.release(reservation)
+            self._unresolved.discard(key)
+            return released
+
+    async def consume_reservation(
+        self, reservation: CashReservation, amount: Decimal
+    ) -> Decimal:
+        """Fill hook: consume ``amount`` from an entry reservation."""
+        return await self.reservation_ledger.consume(reservation, amount)
+
+    async def complete(self, command: OrderCommand) -> None:
+        """Clear the coordinator's unresolved claim after a terminal order outcome."""
+        if not isinstance(command, OrderCommand):
+            raise TypeError("command must be OrderCommand")
+        async with self._lock_for(command.key):
+            self._unresolved.discard(command.key)

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+from dataclasses import dataclass

+
+from mike_trade.execution.coordinator import (
+    DecisionReason,
+    ExecutionKey,

+)
+
+NOW = datetime(2026, 10, 8, 14, 30, tzinfo=UTC)
+D = Decimal
+ZERO = D("0")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Intent:
+    execution_mode: str = "PAPER"
+    account_key: str = "account-1"
+    symbol: str = "AAPL"
+    purpose: str = "ENTRY_LONG"
+    signal_expires_at: datetime = NOW + timedelta(minutes=1)
+    quote_reference_time: datetime = NOW
+    qty: Decimal | None = None
+    notional: Decimal | None = D("60")
+    limit_price: Decimal | None = None
+
+
+class Clock:
+    def __init__(self, now: datetime = NOW) -> None:
+        self.current = now
+
+    def now(self) -> datetime:
+        return self.current
+
+
+class QuoteAges:
+    async def quote_age(self, intent: Intent, now: datetime) -> timedelta:
+        return now - intent.quote_reference_time
+
+
+class NoOpenOrders:
+    async def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool:
+        return False
+
+
+class FirstOpenCheckGate(NoOpenOrders):
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.entered = asyncio.Event()
+        self.release = asyncio.Event()
+        self.calls = 0
+
+    async def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool:
+        self.calls += 1
+        if self.calls == 1:
+            self.entered.set()
+            await self.release.wait()
+        return False
+
+
+class TwoKeyBarrier(NoOpenOrders):
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.arrived = 0
+        self.both_arrived = asyncio.Event()
+        self.release = asyncio.Event()
+
+    async def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool:
+        self.arrived += 1
+        if self.arrived == 2:
+            self.both_arrived.set()
+        await self.release.wait()
+        return False
+
+
+class Positions:
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        held: Decimal = ZERO,
+        committed: Decimal = ZERO,
+        protective: Decimal = ZERO,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.held = held
+        self.committed = committed
+        self.protective = protective
+
+    async def confirmed_long_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        return self.held
+
+    async def committed_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        return self.committed
+
+    async def protective_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        return self.protective
+
+
+class Cash:
+    def __init__(self, available: Decimal) -> None:
+        self.amount = available
+
+    async def available_cash(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        return self.amount
+
+
+def coordinator(
+    *,
+    clock: Clock | None = None,
+    open_orders: NoOpenOrders | None = None,
+    positions: Positions | None = None,
+    cash: Cash | None = None,
+    max_quote_age: timedelta = timedelta(seconds=5),
+) -> OrderCommandCoordinator:
+    return OrderCommandCoordinator(
+        clock=clock or Clock(),
+        quote_age_provider=QuoteAges(),
+        open_order_provider=open_orders or NoOpenOrders(),
+        position_provider=positions or Positions(),
+        buying_power_budget_provider=cash or Cash(D("1000")),
+        max_quote_age=max_quote_age,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_same_account_symbol_concurrent_entries_authorize_exactly_one() -> None:
+    gate = FirstOpenCheckGate()
+    subject = coordinator(open_orders=gate)
+    command = OrderCommand(Intent(), reservation_amount=D("10"))
+
+    first = asyncio.create_task(subject.authorize(command))
+    await gate.entered.wait()
+    second = asyncio.create_task(subject.authorize(command))
+    await asyncio.sleep(0)
+    gate.release.set()
+    decisions = await asyncio.gather(first, second)
+
+    assert [decision.reason for decision in decisions].count(DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED) == 1
+    assert [decision.reason for decision in decisions].count(
+        DecisionReason.REJECTED_OPEN_ORDER

+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_different_symbols_share_one_account_cash_reservation_section() -> None:
+    subject = coordinator(cash=Cash(D("100")))
+    commands = (
+        OrderCommand(Intent(symbol="AAPL", notional=D("75"))),

+

+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio
+async def test_same_symbol_on_different_accounts_is_fully_independent() -> None:
+    barrier = TwoKeyBarrier()
+    subject = coordinator(open_orders=barrier, cash=Cash(D("60")))

+    assert all(decision.reason is DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED for decision in decisions)
+    assert decisions[0].key.account_scope != decisions[1].key.account_scope
+
+
+@pytest.mark.asyncio

+

+async def test_quote_freshness_is_rechecked_after_waiting_for_symbol_lock() -> None:

+"""Serialized, broker-neutral authorization for order-affecting commands.
+
+The coordinator owns only short-lived authorization and cash-reservation state.
+It deliberately does not persist intents, call a broker, or submit orders.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import asyncio
+import inspect
+from collections.abc import Awaitable
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import Protocol, TypeVar
+
+__all__ = [
+    "OrderCommandCoordinator",
+    "OrderCommand",
+    "CommandDecision",
+    "DecisionReason",
+    "CashReservation",
+    "ReservationLedger",
+    "ExecutionKey",
+]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_T = TypeVar("_T")
+
+
+class _Clock(Protocol):
+    def now(self) -> datetime: ...
+
+
+class _IntentLike(Protocol):
+    @property
+    def execution_mode(self) -> str | Enum: ...
+
+    @property
+    def account_key(self) -> str: ...
+
+    @property
+    def symbol(self) -> str: ...
+
+    @property
+    def purpose(self) -> str | Enum: ...
+
+    @property
+    def signal_expires_at(self) -> datetime: ...
+
+    @property
+    def quote_reference_time(self) -> datetime: ...
+
+    @property
+    def qty(self) -> Decimal | None: ...
+
+    @property
+    def notional(self) -> Decimal | None: ...
+
+    @property
+    def limit_price(self) -> Decimal | None: ...
+
+
+class _QuoteAgeProvider(Protocol):
+    def quote_age(
+        self, intent: _IntentLike, now: datetime
+    ) -> timedelta | Awaitable[timedelta]: ...
+
+
+class _OpenOrderProvider(Protocol):
+    def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool | Awaitable[bool]: ...
+
+
+class _PositionProvider(Protocol):
+    def confirmed_long_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+    def committed_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+    def protective_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+
+class _AvailableCashProvider(Protocol):
+    def available_cash(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal | Awaitable[Decimal]: ...
+
+
+async def _resolve(value: _T | Awaitable[_T]) -> _T:
+    if inspect.isawaitable(value):
+        return await value
+    return value
+
+
+def _enum_text(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    raw = getattr(value, "value", value)
+    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string or string-valued enum")
+    return raw.strip().upper()
+
+
+def _text(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
+    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
+    return value.strip()
+
+
+def _decimal(value: object, *, field: str, positive: bool = False) -> Decimal:
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError(f"{field} must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite():
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite")
+    if value < _ZERO or (positive and value == _ZERO):
+        operator = "> 0" if positive else ">= 0"
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be {operator}")
+    return value
+
+
+def _aware(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a timezone-aware datetime")
+    return value
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class ExecutionKey:
+    """Strict isolation key for one mode, account/scenario, and symbol."""
+
+    mode: str | Enum
+    account_id: str
+    symbol: str
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        object.__setattr__(self, "mode", _enum_text(self.mode, field="mode"))
+        object.__setattr__(self, "account_id", _text(self.account_id, field="account_id"))
+        symbol = _text(self.symbol, field="symbol").upper()
+        if any(character.isspace() for character in symbol):
+            raise ValueError("symbol must not contain whitespace")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_intent(cls, intent: _IntentLike) -> ExecutionKey:
+        return cls(intent.execution_mode, intent.account_key, intent.symbol)
+
+    @property
+    def account_scope(self) -> tuple[str, str]:
+        return (_enum_text(self.mode, field="mode"), self.account_id)
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class OrderCommand:
+    """An intent plus coordinator-only reservation/cancellation instructions."""
+
+    intent: _IntentLike
+    reservation_amount: Decimal | None = None
+    cancel_protective_first: bool = False
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        # Structural validation keeps this module independent of f.1's concrete intent.
+        for field in (
+            "execution_mode",
+            "account_key",
+            "symbol",
+            "purpose",
+            "signal_expires_at",
+            "quote_reference_time",
+            "qty",
+            "notional",
+            "limit_price",
+        ):
+            if not hasattr(self.intent, field):
+                raise TypeError(f"intent must provide {field}")
+        if self.reservation_amount is not None:
+            _decimal(self.reservation_amount, field="reservation_amount", positive=True)
+        if not isinstance(self.cancel_protective_first, bool):
+            raise TypeError("cancel_protective_first must be bool")
+
+    @property
+    def key(self) -> ExecutionKey:
+        return ExecutionKey.from_intent(self.intent)
+
+    @property
+    def purpose(self) -> str:
+        return _enum_text(self.intent.purpose, field="purpose")
+
+    @property
+    def requested_cash(self) -> Decimal:
+        if self.reservation_amount is not None:
+            return self.reservation_amount
+        if self.intent.notional is not None:
+            return _decimal(self.intent.notional, field="intent.notional", positive=True)
+        if self.intent.qty is not None and self.intent.limit_price is not None:
+            quantity = _decimal(self.intent.qty, field="intent.qty", positive=True)
+            price = _decimal(self.intent.limit_price, field="intent.limit_price", positive=True)

+class DecisionReason(Enum):
+    AUTHORIZED = "AUTHORIZED"
+    REJECTED_STALE_SIGNAL = "REJECTED_STALE_SIGNAL"
+    REJECTED_STALE_QUOTE = "REJECTED_STALE_QUOTE"
+    REJECTED_INSUFFICIENT_CASH = "REJECTED_INSUFFICIENT_CASH"
+    REJECTED_OPEN_ORDER = "REJECTED_OPEN_ORDER"
+    REJECTED_OVERSELL = "REJECTED_OVERSELL"
+    REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL = "REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL"

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class CashReservation:
+    """Immutable receipt for cash held in a single account-scoped ledger."""
+
+    reservation_id: str
+    execution_key: ExecutionKey

+

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class CommandDecision:

+    key: ExecutionKey
+    purpose: str
+    reservation: CashReservation | None = None
+    available_cash: Decimal | None = None
+    available_quantity: Decimal | None = None
+    protective_quantity: Decimal | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(self.reason, DecisionReason):
+            raise TypeError("reason must be DecisionReason")
+        if not isinstance(self.key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("key must be ExecutionKey")
+        object.__setattr__(self, "purpose", _enum_text(self.purpose, field="purpose"))
+        for field in ("available_cash", "available_quantity", "protective_quantity"):
+            value = getattr(self, field)
+            if value is not None:
+                _decimal(value, field=field)
+
+    @property
+    def authorized(self) -> bool:
+        return self.reason is DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED
+
+    @property
+    def requires_cancel_confirmation(self) -> bool:
+        return self.reason is DecisionReason.REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL
+
+    @property
+    def status(self) -> DecisionReason:
+        """Alias useful to callers that name the typed outcome ``status``."""
+        return self.reason

+
+class ReservationLedger:
+    """Account-isolated Decimal cash holds with atomic reserve/release/consume hooks."""
+
+    def __init__(self, available_cash_provider: _AvailableCashProvider) -> None:
+        self._provider = available_cash_provider
+        self._locks: dict[tuple[str, str], asyncio.Lock] = {}
+        self._reservations: dict[str, tuple[CashReservation, Decimal]] = {}
+        self._sequence = 0
+
+    def _lock_for(self, account_scope: tuple[str, str]) -> asyncio.Lock:
+        lock = self._locks.get(account_scope)
+        if lock is None:
+            lock = asyncio.Lock()
+            self._locks[account_scope] = lock
+        return lock
+
+    def _held(self, account_scope: tuple[str, str]) -> Decimal:
+        return sum(
+            (
+                remaining
+                for reservation, remaining in self._reservations.values()
+                if reservation.execution_key.account_scope == account_scope
+            ),
+            start=_ZERO,
+        )
+
+    async def available(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        if not isinstance(key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("key must be ExecutionKey")
+        async with self._lock_for(key.account_scope):
+            return await self._available_locked(key)
+
+    async def _available_locked(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        supplied = await _resolve(self._provider.available_cash(key))
+        base = _decimal(supplied, field="available cash")
+        available = base - self._held(key.account_scope)
+        return max(_ZERO, available)
+
+    async def reserve(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, amount: Decimal
+    ) -> tuple[CashReservation | None, Decimal]:
+        if not isinstance(key, ExecutionKey):
+            raise TypeError("key must be ExecutionKey")
+        requested = _decimal(amount, field="amount", positive=True)
+        async with self._lock_for(key.account_scope):
+            available = await self._available_locked(key)
+            if requested > available:
+                return None, available
+            self._sequence += 1
+            reservation = CashReservation(f"cash-{self._sequence}", key, requested)
+            self._reservations[reservation.reservation_id] = (reservation, requested)
+            return reservation, available - requested
+
+    async def release(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> Decimal:
+        """Release the exact unconsumed amount and return that released amount."""
+        stored = self._stored(reservation)
+        async with self._lock_for(stored.execution_key.account_scope):
+            stored, remaining = self._pop_checked(reservation)
+            return remaining
+
+    async def consume(self, reservation: CashReservation, amount: Decimal) -> Decimal:
+        """Consume part of a hold and return its exact remaining Decimal amount."""
+        consumed = _decimal(amount, field="amount", positive=True)
+        stored = self._stored(reservation)
+        async with self._lock_for(stored.execution_key.account_scope):
+            stored, remaining = self._checked(reservation)
+            if consumed > remaining:
+                raise ValueError("consumed amount exceeds remaining reservation")
+            new_remaining = remaining - consumed
+            if new_remaining == _ZERO:
+                del self._reservations[stored.reservation_id]
+            else:
+                self._reservations[stored.reservation_id] = (stored, new_remaining)
+            return new_remaining
+
+    async def remaining(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> Decimal:
+        stored = self._stored(reservation)
+        async with self._lock_for(stored.execution_key.account_scope):
+            _, remaining = self._checked(reservation)
+            return remaining
+
+    def _stored(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> CashReservation:
+        if not isinstance(reservation, CashReservation):
+            raise TypeError("reservation must be CashReservation")
+        found = self._reservations.get(reservation.reservation_id)
+        if found is None:
+            raise KeyError(f"unknown reservation: {reservation.reservation_id}")
+        return found[0]
+
+    def _checked(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> tuple[CashReservation, Decimal]:
+        found = self._reservations.get(reservation.reservation_id)
+        if found is None or found[0] != reservation:
+            raise KeyError(f"unknown reservation: {reservation.reservation_id}")
+        return found
+
+    def _pop_checked(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> tuple[CashReservation, Decimal]:
+        found = self._checked(reservation)
+        del self._reservations[reservation.reservation_id]
+        return found
+

+class OrderCommandCoordinator:
+    """Serialize and authorize commands without performing submission side effects."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        clock: _Clock,
+        quote_age_provider: _QuoteAgeProvider,
+        open_order_provider: _OpenOrderProvider,
+        position_provider: _PositionProvider,
+        buying_power_budget_provider: _AvailableCashProvider,
+        max_quote_age: timedelta,
+        reservation_ledger: ReservationLedger | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(max_quote_age, timedelta) or max_quote_age < timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("max_quote_age must be a non-negative timedelta")
+        self._clock = clock
+        self._quote_age_provider = quote_age_provider
+        self._open_order_provider = open_order_provider
+        self._position_provider = position_provider
+        self._max_quote_age = max_quote_age
+        self._symbol_locks: dict[ExecutionKey, asyncio.Lock] = {}
+        self._unresolved: set[ExecutionKey] = set()
+        self.reservation_ledger = reservation_ledger or ReservationLedger(
+            buying_power_budget_provider
+        )
+
+    def _lock_for(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> asyncio.Lock:
+        lock = self._symbol_locks.get(key)
+        if lock is None:
+            lock = asyncio.Lock()
+            self._symbol_locks[key] = lock
+        return lock
+
+    async def authorize(self, command: OrderCommand) -> CommandDecision:
+        if not isinstance(command, OrderCommand):
+            raise TypeError("command must be OrderCommand")
+        key = command.key
+        purpose = command.purpose
+        async with self._lock_for(key):
+            # Every mutable/checker-backed decision is intentionally made here,
+            # after any earlier command for this exact isolation key completes.
+            now = _aware(self._clock.now(), field="clock.now()")
+            expires_at = _aware(
+                command.intent.signal_expires_at, field="intent.signal_expires_at"
+            )
+            if now >= expires_at:
+                return CommandDecision(DecisionReason.REJECTED_STALE_SIGNAL, key, purpose)
+
+            quote_age = await _resolve(self._quote_age_provider.quote_age(command.intent, now))
+            if not isinstance(quote_age, timedelta):
+                raise TypeError("quote_age provider must return timedelta")
+            if quote_age < timedelta(0) or quote_age > self._max_quote_age:
+                return CommandDecision(DecisionReason.REJECTED_STALE_QUOTE, key, purpose)
+
+            if key in self._unresolved or await _resolve(
+                self._open_order_provider.has_open_or_unresolved_order(key, purpose)
+            ):
+                return CommandDecision(DecisionReason.REJECTED_OPEN_ORDER, key, purpose)
+
+            if purpose == "ENTRY_LONG":
+                reservation, available = await self.reservation_ledger.reserve(
+                    key, command.requested_cash
+                )
+                if reservation is None:
+                    return CommandDecision(
+                        DecisionReason.REJECTED_INSUFFICIENT_CASH,
+                        key,
+                        purpose,
+                        available_cash=available,
+                    )
+                self._unresolved.add(key)
+                return CommandDecision(
+                    DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED,
+                    key,
+                    purpose,
+                    reservation=reservation,
+                    available_cash=available,
+                )
+
+            return await self._authorize_sell_locked(command, key, purpose)
+
+    async def _authorize_sell_locked(
+        self, command: OrderCommand, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> CommandDecision:
+        requested = _decimal(command.intent.qty, field="intent.qty", positive=True)
+        held = _decimal(
+            await _resolve(self._position_provider.confirmed_long_quantity(key)),
+            field="confirmed long quantity",
+        )
+        committed = _decimal(
+            await _resolve(self._position_provider.committed_sell_quantity(key)),
+            field="committed sell quantity",
+        )
+        protective = _decimal(
+            await _resolve(self._position_provider.protective_sell_quantity(key)),
+            field="protective sell quantity",
+        )
+        if protective > committed:
+            raise ValueError("protective sell quantity cannot exceed committed sell quantity")
+
+        available = max(_ZERO, held - committed)
+        if requested <= available:
+            self._unresolved.add(key)
+            return CommandDecision(
+                DecisionReason.AUTHORIZED,
+                key,
+                purpose,
+                available_quantity=available,
+                protective_quantity=protective,
+            )
+
+        available_after_protective_cancel = max(_ZERO, held - (committed - protective))
+        if (
+            command.cancel_protective_first
+            and protective > _ZERO
+            and requested <= available_after_protective_cancel
+        ):
+            self._unresolved.add(key)
+            return CommandDecision(
+                DecisionReason.REQUIRES_PROTECTIVE_CANCEL,
+                key,
+                purpose,
+                available_quantity=available_after_protective_cancel,
+                protective_quantity=protective,
+            )
+
+        return CommandDecision(
+            DecisionReason.REJECTED_OVERSELL,
+            key,
+            purpose,
+            available_quantity=available,
+            protective_quantity=protective,
+        )
+
+    async def release_reservation(self, reservation: CashReservation) -> Decimal:
+        """Abandon an entry authorization and release its remaining cash exactly."""
+        key = reservation.execution_key
+        async with self._lock_for(key):
+            released = await self.reservation_ledger.release(reservation)
+            self._unresolved.discard(key)
+            return released
+
+    async def consume_reservation(
+        self, reservation: CashReservation, amount: Decimal
+    ) -> Decimal:
+        """Fill hook: consume ``amount`` from an entry reservation."""
+        return await self.reservation_ledger.consume(reservation, amount)
+
+    async def complete(self, command: OrderCommand) -> None:
+        """Clear the coordinator's unresolved claim after a terminal order outcome."""
+        if not isinstance(command, OrderCommand):
+            raise TypeError("command must be OrderCommand")
+        async with self._lock_for(command.key):
+            self._unresolved.discard(command.key)

+class QuoteAges:

+class NoOpenOrders:

+        return False
+

+class FirstOpenCheckGate(NoOpenOrders):
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.entered = asyncio.Event()
+        self.release = asyncio.Event()
+        self.calls = 0
+
+    async def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool:
+        self.calls += 1
+        if self.calls == 1:
+            self.entered.set()
+            await self.release.wait()
+        return False
+
+
+class TwoKeyBarrier(NoOpenOrders):
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.arrived = 0

+        self.release = asyncio.Event()
+
+    async def has_open_or_unresolved_order(
+        self, key: ExecutionKey, purpose: str
+    ) -> bool:
+        self.arrived += 1
+        if self.arrived == 2:

+        await self.release.wait()
+        return False
+
+

+        return self.held
+
+    async def committed_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:

+
+    async def protective_sell_quantity(self, key: ExecutionKey) -> Decimal:
+        return self.protective
+

## Core Principles

- Respect:
  - selected_backend
  - verification_profile
  - acceptance_criteria
- If a task conflicts with architecture constraints or phase scope:
  - STOP and report conflict

---

## Backend Rules

- Backends must:
  - execute commands deterministically
  - capture stdout, stderr, exit_code
  - not silently fail
- Do not invent backend interfaces; use existing adapters
- Codex CLI, Aider, Gemini, Claude Code should be invoked through backends only

---

## Verification Rules

- Verification must be deterministic
- Preferred checks:
  - pytest
  - python -m py_compile
- Do not rely on model self-evaluation

---

## Execution Control Flow (PERMANENT ARCHITECTURAL RULE)

**HEURISTIC INFERENCE MUST NEVER PARTICIPATE IN ABRACAPOCUS EXECUTION CONTROL FLOW.**

Abracapocus must not determine execution success, failure, acceptance,
rejection, blocking, retry eligibility, phase progression, or completion from
heuristic inference. A heuristic is any conclusion that is *inferred* rather
than *directly established by an explicit executable contract or a concrete
runtime fact*.

Runtime status is derived ONLY from concrete, mechanically observable facts:

1. The backend process exit code. A backend that exits `0` (with no hard
   write-policy violation) is a successful execution.
2. Objectively observed hard write-policy violations (changed paths outside the
   declared allowed write paths).
3. Explicit operator-authored commands (task/phase verification the plan
   explicitly contains). Their raw results are reported, kept DISTINCT from
   backend execution status.
4. Objective orchestrator failures with direct evidence (backend could not
   launch, required document could not be parsed, subprocess infrastructure
   failed).

**Verification results are observational and must not rewrite backend execution
status.** A verifier returning non-zero must NEVER, by itself, turn a
successful backend execution into unverified, stop a phase, or trigger an
automatic rerun. Verification is the result of a command, not authority to
rewrite history.

**Execution control:** Task-local problems (non-zero exit, timeout,
write-policy violation, frame failure, backend launch failure) produce
acceptance status ``"unverified"`` with truthful evidence preserved. They
MUST NOT stop sibling tasks, later phases, or the plan. Only operator
cancellation (SIGINT/SIGTERM/dashboard cancel) may terminate a run
(acceptance status ``"interrupted"``). Dependencies are ordering constraints,
not acceptance gates — any terminal attempt outcome satisfies a dependency
edge. The status ``"failed"`` is banned from acceptance output.

Do NOT reintroduce -- under any name, feature flag, "advisory" wrapper, or
compatibility mode -- context completeness/sufficiency scoring, change or
architecture assessment used as a gate, intent/scope matching, reconciliation
gates, no-progress judgments, confidence/risk scores, model/LLM/reviewer
judgments over status, shadow/adaptive/secondary-verification gates, or
heuristic retry/failure-classification control flow. Failure classification may
only *summarize* an already-established concrete failure; it must never create
one. Retries are permitted only for explicitly defined mechanical backend
failures. Future agents must not add these systems back.

---

## Git Rules

- Do not commit:
  - runtime_state.json
  - reports/
  - logs/
  - virtual environments
- Do not modify .gitignore unless required by task
- Do not create excessive commits; prefer grouped logical commits

---

## Forbidden Changes

- Adding dependencies without justification
- Modifying unrelated files
- Deleting important files
- Bypassing verification

---

## Planning Rules

- Plans are multi-phase
- Completed sections are immutable
- Remaining sections may be updated

  - project brief
  - architecture constraints
  - active phase

---

## Reporting

- All executions must produce structured reports
- Reports must include:
  - changed files
  - verification results
  - assessment

---

## Behavior

- Do not ask unnecessary questions
- Do not stall execution
- Do not perform broad scans unless required
- Prefer direct action over analysis

---

## Priority Order

This ordering guides *implementation decisions* only. It does NOT make
verification an acceptance authority: verification results are observational
(see "Execution Control Flow"), and never override a concrete backend
execution result.

1. Architecture constraints
2. Task definition
3. Verification results (observational signal, not acceptance authority)
4. Plan guidance

If conflicts occur, follow this order.

def _require_non_empty_str(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty str")
    return value.strip()


def _require_strategy_key(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field)
    if _STRATEGY_KEY_RE.fullmatch(result) is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be lowercase snake_case; got {value!r}")
    return result


def _require_symbol(value: object, *, field: str) -> str:
    result = _require_non_empty_str(value, field=field).upper()
    if any(character.isspace() for character in result):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must not contain whitespace; got {value!r}")
    return result


def _require_utc(value: object, *, field: str) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(value, datetime):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a datetime; got {type(value).__name__}")
    if value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be timezone-aware")
    return value.astimezone(UTC)


def _to_decimal(value: object, *, field: str) -> Decimal:
    if isinstance(value, bool) or isinstance(value, float):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str; got {type(value).__name__}")
    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        result = value
    elif isinstance(value, int):
        result = Decimal(value)
    elif isinstance(value, str):
        text = value.strip()
        if not text:
            raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty numeric string")
        try:
            result = Decimal(text)
        except InvalidOperation:
            raise ValueError(f"{field} is not a valid decimal string: {value!r}") from None
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be Decimal, int, or str; got {type(value).__name__}")
    if not result.is_finite():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be finite; got {result!s}")
    return result

def make_signal_id(
    instance_id: str,
    symbol: str,
    action: SignalAction,
    bar_time: datetime,
) -> str:
    """Return a stable SHA-256 identifier for one instance/action/bar."""
    normalized_instance = _require_non_empty_str(instance_id, field="instance_id")
    normalized_symbol = _require_symbol(symbol, field="symbol")
    if not isinstance(action, SignalAction):
        raise ValueError(f"action must be SignalAction; got {type(action).__name__}")
    normalized_bar_time = _require_utc(bar_time, field="bar_time")
    timestamp = normalized_bar_time.isoformat(timespec="microseconds").replace("+00:00", "Z")
    canonical = json.dumps(
        [normalized_instance, normalized_symbol, action.value, timestamp],
        ensure_ascii=True,
        separators=(",", ":"),
    )
    return hashlib.sha256(canonical.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

def _require_decimal(

    *,

) -> Decimal:
    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):

    TRAILING_STOP = "TRAILING_STOP"
    MANUAL_CLOSE = "MANUAL_CLOSE"
    SAFETY_EXIT = "SAFETY_EXIT"


def _text(value: object, field: str) -> str:
    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value.strip():
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a non-empty string")
    return value.strip()


def _utc(value: object, field: str) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a UTC-aware datetime")
    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must use UTC")
    return value.astimezone(UTC)


def _positive_decimal(value: object, field: str) -> Decimal | None:
    if value is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
        raise TypeError(f"{field} must be Decimal")
    if not value.is_finite() or value <= _ZERO:
        raise ValueError(f"{field} must be a finite positive Decimal")
    return value


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OrderIntent:
    """Immutable instruction whose durable identity precedes broker submission."""

    intent_id: str
    execution_mode: AccountEnvironment
    account_key: str
    symbol: str
    side: OrderSide
    purpose: OrderPurpose
    position_cycle_id: str
    order_type: OrderType
    time_in_force: TimeInForce
    signal_bar_time: datetime
    signal_expires_at: datetime
    quote_reference_time: datetime
    client_order_id: str
    attempt_number: int
    created_at: datetime
    originating_strategy_id: str | None = None
    qty: Decimal | None = None
    notional: Decimal | None = None
    limit_price: Decimal | None = None
    stop_price: Decimal | None = None
    trail_price: Decimal | None = None
    trail_percent: Decimal | None = None

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        for field in ("intent_id", "account_key", "position_cycle_id", "client_order_id"):
            object.__setattr__(self, field, _text(getattr(self, field), field))
        symbol = _text(self.symbol, "symbol").upper()
        if any(character.isspace() for character in symbol):
            raise ValueError("symbol must not contain whitespace")
        object.__setattr__(self, "symbol", symbol)

        if not isinstance(self.execution_mode, AccountEnvironment):
            raise TypeError("execution_mode must be an AccountEnvironment")
        if self.execution_mode not in {
            AccountEnvironment.SHADOW,
            AccountEnvironment.PAPER,
            AccountEnvironment.LIVE,
        }:
            raise ValueError("execution_mode must be SHADOW, PAPER, or LIVE")
        if not isinstance(self.side, OrderSide):
            raise TypeError("side must be an OrderSide")
        if not isinstance(self.purpose, OrderPurpose):
            raise TypeError("purpose must be an OrderPurpose")
        if not isinstance(self.order_type, OrderType):
            raise TypeError("order_type must be an OrderType")
        if not isinstance(self.time_in_force, TimeInForce):
            raise TypeError("time_in_force must be a TimeInForce")
        if isinstance(self.attempt_number, bool) or not isinstance(self.attempt_number, int):
            raise TypeError("attempt_number must be int")
        if self.attempt_number < 0:
            raise ValueError("attempt_number must be >= 0")

        for field in (
            "signal_bar_time",
            "signal_expires_at",
            "quote_reference_time",
            "created_at",
        ):
            object.__setattr__(self, field, _utc(getattr(self, field), field))
        if self.signal_expires_at < self.signal_bar_time:
            raise ValueError("signal_expires_at must not precede signal_bar_time")

        if self.originating_strategy_id is not None:
            object.__setattr__(
                self,
                "originating_strategy_id",
                _text(self.originating_strategy_id, "originating_strategy_id"),
            )

        for field in (
            "qty",
            "notional",
            "limit_price",
            "stop_price",
            "trail_price",
            "trail_percent",
        ):
            object.__setattr__(self, field, _positive_decimal(getattr(self, field), field))
        if (self.qty is None) == (self.notional is None):
            raise ValueError("exactly one of qty or notional is required")
        self._validate_prices()

        required_side = OrderSide.BUY if self.purpose is OrderPurpose.ENTRY_LONG else OrderSide.SELL
        if self.side is not required_side:
            if self.purpose is OrderPurpose.ENTRY_LONG:
                raise ValueError("short-opening sides are disabled; ENTRY_LONG requires BUY")
            raise ValueError(f"{self.purpose.value} is a long exit and requires SELL")

    @property
    def account_scope_id(self) -> str:
        """Environment-qualified persistence identity."""
        return f"{self.execution_mode.value.lower()}:{self.account_key}"

    @classmethod
    def create(cls, **values: Any) -> OrderIntent:
        """Build an intent using the existing stable client-order-ID helper.

        Callers may still invoke the normal constructor when a provider-neutral
        externally allocated ID is already durable.
        """
        if "client_order_id" in values:
            raise TypeError("create() derives client_order_id; do not pass it")
        try:
            mode = values["execution_mode"]
            account_key = values["account_key"]
            cycle_id = values["position_cycle_id"]
            purpose = values["purpose"]
            attempt = values["attempt_number"]
        except KeyError as exc:
            raise TypeError(f"create() missing required argument: {exc.args[0]}") from None
        if not isinstance(purpose, OrderPurpose):
            raise TypeError("purpose must be an OrderPurpose")
        # This is intentionally lazy: the intent model and durable store stay
        # usable without importing a concrete broker adapter.
        from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.orders import OrderPurpose as AlpacaOrderPurpose
        from mike_trade.brokers.alpaca.orders import make_client_order_id

        alpaca_purpose = {
            OrderPurpose.ENTRY_LONG: AlpacaOrderPurpose.ENTRY,
            OrderPurpose.EXIT_LONG: AlpacaOrderPurpose.EXIT,
            OrderPurpose.PROTECTIVE_STOP: AlpacaOrderPurpose.PROTECTIVE_STOP,
            OrderPurpose.TRAILING_STOP: AlpacaOrderPurpose.TRAILING_STOP,
            OrderPurpose.MANUAL_CLOSE: AlpacaOrderPurpose.MANUAL_CLOSE,
            OrderPurpose.SAFETY_EXIT: AlpacaOrderPurpose.SAFETY_EXIT,
        }[purpose]
        values["client_order_id"] = make_client_order_id(
            mode, account_key, cycle_id, alpaca_purpose, attempt
        )
        return cls(**values)

    def _validate_prices(self) -> None:
        if self.order_type in {OrderType.LIMIT, OrderType.STOP_LIMIT}:
            if self.limit_price is None:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.order_type.value} requires limit_price")
        elif self.limit_price is not None:
            raise ValueError(f"{self.order_type.value} must not specify limit_price")

        if self.order_type in {OrderType.STOP, OrderType.STOP_LIMIT}:
            if self.stop_price is None:
                raise ValueError(f"{self.order_type.value} requires stop_price")
        elif self.stop_price is not None:
            raise ValueError(f"{self.order_type.value} must not specify stop_price")

        trail_count = int(self.trail_price is not None) + int(self.trail_percent is not None)
        if self.order_type is OrderType.TRAILING_STOP:
            if trail_count != 1:
                raise ValueError("TRAILING_STOP requires exactly one trail value")
        elif trail_count:
            raise ValueError(f"{self.order_type.value} must not specify a trail value")

def _parse_time(value: object, field: str) -> datetime:
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError(f"persisted {field} must be an ISO timestamp")
    parsed = datetime.fromisoformat(value[:-1] + "+00:00" if value.endswith("Z") else value)
    return _utc(parsed, field)


def _decimal_from_payload(payload: Mapping[str, Any], field: str) -> Decimal | None:
    value = payload.get(field)
    if value is None:
        return None
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        raise ValueError(f"persisted {field} must be a decimal string")
    return Decimal(value)


def _from_recorded(event: RecordedEvent) -> OrderIntent:
    if event.event_type != _INTENT_EVENT:
        raise ValueError("client_order_id belongs to a non-intent journal event")
    payload = event.payload
    if (
        not isinstance(payload, Mapping)
        or payload.get("status") != OrderStatus.INTENT_PERSISTED.value
    ):
        raise ValueError("persisted order intent payload has an invalid initial status")
    return OrderIntent(
        intent_id=payload["intent_id"],
        execution_mode=AccountEnvironment(payload["execution_mode"]),
        account_key=payload["account_key"],
        symbol=payload["symbol"],
        side=OrderSide(payload["side"]),
        purpose=OrderPurpose(payload["purpose"]),
        position_cycle_id=payload["position_cycle_id"],
        originating_strategy_id=payload.get("originating_strategy_id"),
        qty=_decimal_from_payload(payload, "qty"),
        notional=_decimal_from_payload(payload, "notional"),
        order_type=OrderType(payload["order_type"]),
        limit_price=_decimal_from_payload(payload, "limit_price"),
        stop_price=_decimal_from_payload(payload, "stop_price"),
        trail_price=_decimal_from_payload(payload, "trail_price"),
        trail_percent=_decimal_from_payload(payload, "trail_percent"),
        time_in_force=TimeInForce(payload["time_in_force"]),
        signal_bar_time=_parse_time(payload["signal_bar_time"], "signal_bar_time"),
        signal_expires_at=_parse_time(payload["signal_expires_at"], "signal_expires_at"),
        quote_reference_time=_parse_time(payload["quote_reference_time"], "quote_reference_time"),
        client_order_id=payload["client_order_id"],
        attempt_number=payload["attempt_number"],
        created_at=_parse_time(payload["created_at"], "created_at"),
    )


class IntentStore:
    """Append-only intent persistence with scoped client-ID idempotency."""

    def __init__(self, journal: DomainEventJournal) -> None:
        if not isinstance(journal, DomainEventJournal):
            raise TypeError("journal must be a DomainEventJournal")
        self._journal = journal

    def persist_intent(
        self,
        intent: OrderIntent,
        *,
        submission_hook: Callable[[OrderIntent], Any] | None = None,
    ) -> OrderIntent:
        if not isinstance(intent, OrderIntent):
            raise TypeError("intent must be an OrderIntent")
        key = f"{_IDEMPOTENCY_PREFIX}{intent.client_order_id}"
        existing = self._journal.get_by_idempotency_key(intent.account_scope_id, key)
        if existing is not None:
            return _from_recorded(existing)

"""Provider-neutral order status transitions.

Status changes deliberately do not own executed quantity.  An event can carry
``filled_qty`` only when it represents a fill-bearing update, leaving the fill
ledger as the authoritative owner of quantity changes.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from decimal import Decimal
from enum import Enum
from typing import Literal

__all__ = [
    "OrderStatus",
    "OrderEvent",
    "TransitionResult",
    "IllegalOrderTransition",
    "apply_transition",
    "TERMINAL_STATUSES",
]


class OrderStatus(Enum):
    INTENT_PERSISTED = "INTENT_PERSISTED"
    SUBMITTING = "SUBMITTING"
    ACCEPTED = "ACCEPTED"
    PENDING = "PENDING"
    PARTIALLY_FILLED = "PARTIALLY_FILLED"
    FILLED = "FILLED"
    REJECTED = "REJECTED"
    CANCEL_PENDING = "CANCEL_PENDING"
    CANCELED = "CANCELED"
    EXPIRED = "EXPIRED"
    REPLACED = "REPLACED"
    SUSPENDED = "SUSPENDED"
    UNKNOWN = "UNKNOWN"


TERMINAL_STATUSES = frozenset(
    {
        OrderStatus.FILLED,
        OrderStatus.REJECTED,
        OrderStatus.CANCELED,
        OrderStatus.EXPIRED,
        OrderStatus.REPLACED,
    }
)


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class OrderEvent:
    """One normalized broker/order-lifecycle observation.

    ``broker_lookup`` is required when resolving ``UNKNOWN``.  ``broker_confirmed``
    distinguishes final broker state from a local cancel/replace request or an
    acknowledgement that has not yet confirmed the final state.
    """

    status: OrderStatus
    filled_qty: Decimal | None = None
    broker_lookup: bool = False
    broker_confirmed: bool = True

    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
        if not isinstance(self.status, OrderStatus):
            raise TypeError("status must be an OrderStatus")
        if not isinstance(self.broker_lookup, bool):
            raise TypeError("broker_lookup must be bool")
        if not isinstance(self.broker_confirmed, bool):
            raise TypeError("broker_confirmed must be bool")
        is_fill_status = self.status in {
            OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED,
            OrderStatus.FILLED,
        }
        if self.filled_qty is None:
            return
        if not isinstance(self.filled_qty, Decimal):
            raise TypeError("filled_qty must be Decimal")
        if not self.filled_qty.is_finite() or self.filled_qty <= 0:
            raise ValueError("filled_qty must be a finite positive Decimal")
        if not is_fill_status:
            raise ValueError("filled_qty may change only through fill-bearing events")


class IllegalOrderTransition(ValueError):
    """Typed evidence that an event cannot change the current order state."""

    def __init__(self, current: OrderStatus, event: OrderEvent, reason: str) -> None:
        self.current = current
        self.event = event
        self.reason = reason
        super().__init__(
            f"illegal order transition {current.value} -> {event.status.value}: {reason}"
        )


@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
class TransitionResult:
    previous_status: OrderStatus
    status: OrderStatus
    event: OrderEvent
    outcome: Literal["accepted", "ignored", "illegal"]
    error: IllegalOrderTransition | None = None

    @property
    def accepted(self) -> bool:
        return self.outcome == "accepted"

    @property
    def ignored(self) -> bool:
        return self.outcome == "ignored"

    @property
    def illegal(self) -> bool:
        return self.outcome == "illegal"

    @property
    def filled_qty(self) -> Decimal | None:
        """Return fill data only when its fill-bearing transition was accepted."""
        return self.event.filled_qty if self.accepted else None

    def raise_for_illegal(self) -> None:
        if self.error is not None:
            raise self.error


# The table is the complete transition policy.  Request acknowledgements are
# represented by CANCEL_PENDING; REPLACED appears only as broker-confirmed state.
_TRANSITIONS: dict[OrderStatus, frozenset[OrderStatus]] = {
    OrderStatus.INTENT_PERSISTED: frozenset({OrderStatus.SUBMITTING}),
    OrderStatus.SUBMITTING: frozenset(
        {
            OrderStatus.ACCEPTED,
            OrderStatus.PENDING,
            OrderStatus.REJECTED,
            OrderStatus.UNKNOWN,
        }
    ),
    OrderStatus.ACCEPTED: frozenset(
        {
            OrderStatus.PENDING,
            OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED,
            OrderStatus.FILLED,
            OrderStatus.REJECTED,
            OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING,
            OrderStatus.CANCELED,
            OrderStatus.EXPIRED,
            OrderStatus.REPLACED,
            OrderStatus.SUSPENDED,
        }
    ),
    OrderStatus.PENDING: frozenset(
        {
            OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED,
            OrderStatus.FILLED,
            OrderStatus.REJECTED,
            OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING,
            OrderStatus.CANCELED,
            OrderStatus.EXPIRED,
            OrderStatus.REPLACED,
            OrderStatus.SUSPENDED,
        }
    ),
    OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED: frozenset(
        {
            OrderStatus.FILLED,
            OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING,
            OrderStatus.CANCELED,
            OrderStatus.EXPIRED,
            OrderStatus.REPLACED,
            OrderStatus.SUSPENDED,
        }
    ),
    OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING: frozenset(
        {
            OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED,
            OrderStatus.FILLED,
            OrderStatus.CANCELED,
            OrderStatus.EXPIRED,
            OrderStatus.REPLACED,
            OrderStatus.SUSPENDED,
        }
    ),
    OrderStatus.SUSPENDED: frozenset(
        {
            OrderStatus.ACCEPTED,
            OrderStatus.PENDING,
            OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED,
            OrderStatus.FILLED,
            OrderStatus.REJECTED,
            OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING,
            OrderStatus.CANCELED,
            OrderStatus.EXPIRED,
            OrderStatus.REPLACED,
        }
    ),
    OrderStatus.UNKNOWN: frozenset(
        {
            OrderStatus.ACCEPTED,
            OrderStatus.PENDING,
            OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED,
            OrderStatus.FILLED,
            OrderStatus.REJECTED,
            OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING,
            OrderStatus.CANCELED,
            OrderStatus.EXPIRED,
            OrderStatus.REPLACED,
            OrderStatus.SUSPENDED,
        }
    ),
    OrderStatus.FILLED: frozenset(),
    OrderStatus.REJECTED: frozenset(),
    OrderStatus.CANCELED: frozenset(),
    OrderStatus.EXPIRED: frozenset(),
    OrderStatus.REPLACED: frozenset(),
}

_PROGRESS_RANK = {
    OrderStatus.INTENT_PERSISTED: 0,
    OrderStatus.SUBMITTING: 1,
    OrderStatus.ACCEPTED: 2,
    OrderStatus.PENDING: 3,
    OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED: 4,
    OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING: 5,
}


def _illegal(current: OrderStatus, event: OrderEvent, reason: str) -> TransitionResult:
    error = IllegalOrderTransition(current, event, reason)
    return TransitionResult(current, current, event, "illegal", error)


def apply_transition(current: OrderStatus, event: OrderEvent) -> TransitionResult:
    """Apply one event without side effects, returning explicit disposition evidence."""
    if not isinstance(current, OrderStatus):
        raise TypeError("current must be an OrderStatus")
    if not isinstance(event, OrderEvent):
        raise TypeError("event must be an OrderEvent")

    target = event.status
    if target is current:
        return TransitionResult(current, current, event, "ignored")
    if current in TERMINAL_STATUSES:
        return _illegal(current, event, "terminal states are immutable")
    if current is OrderStatus.UNKNOWN and not event.broker_lookup:
        return _illegal(current, event, "UNKNOWN may be resolved only by broker lookup")
    if target in {OrderStatus.CANCELED, OrderStatus.REPLACED} and not event.broker_confirmed:
        return _illegal(current, event, f"{target.value} requires broker confirmation")
    if (
        current is OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING
        and target in {OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED, OrderStatus.FILLED}
        and event.filled_qty is None
    ):
        return TransitionResult(current, current, event, "ignored")

    if target in _TRANSITIONS[current]:
        return TransitionResult(current, target, event, "accepted")

    current_rank = _PROGRESS_RANK.get(current)
    target_rank = _PROGRESS_RANK.get(target)
    if current_rank is not None and target_rank is not None and target_rank < current_rank:
        return TransitionResult(current, current, event, "ignored")

    return _illegal(current, event, "edge is absent from the transition table")

def test_every_legal_edge_is_accepted(current: OrderStatus, target: OrderStatus) -> None:
    result = apply_transition(current, event_for(current, target))

    assert result.accepted
    assert not result.ignored
    assert not result.illegal
    assert result.previous_status is current
    assert result.status is target


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("current", "target"),
    [
        (OrderStatus.INTENT_PERSISTED, OrderStatus.ACCEPTED),
        (OrderStatus.INTENT_PERSISTED, OrderStatus.FILLED),
        (OrderStatus.SUBMITTING, OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING),
        (OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED, OrderStatus.REJECTED),
    ],
)
def test_representative_illegal_edges_return_typed_error(
    current: OrderStatus, target: OrderStatus
) -> None:
    result = apply_transition(current, event_for(current, target))

    assert result.illegal
    assert result.status is current
    assert isinstance(result.error, IllegalOrderTransition)
    with pytest.raises(IllegalOrderTransition):
        result.raise_for_illegal()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("terminal", TERMINAL_STATUSES)
def test_terminal_states_are_immutable_but_same_state_is_idempotent(
    terminal: OrderStatus,
) -> None:
    same = apply_transition(terminal, OrderEvent(terminal))
    assert same.ignored
    assert same.status is terminal

    other = OrderStatus.REJECTED if terminal is not OrderStatus.REJECTED else OrderStatus.CANCELED
    changed = apply_transition(terminal, event_for(terminal, other))
    assert changed.illegal
    assert changed.status is terminal


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("current", "stale"),
    [
        (OrderStatus.PENDING, OrderStatus.ACCEPTED),
        (OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED, OrderStatus.PENDING),
        (OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING, OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED),
        (OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING, OrderStatus.ACCEPTED),
    ],
)
def test_stale_lower_rank_updates_are_ignored(
    current: OrderStatus, stale: OrderStatus
) -> None:
    # CANCEL_PENDING -> PARTIALLY_FILLED is a legal race only when it carries a fill.
    result = apply_transition(current, OrderEvent(stale))
    assert result.ignored
    assert result.status is current


@pytest.mark.parametrize("fill_status", [OrderStatus.PARTIALLY_FILLED, OrderStatus.FILLED])
def test_cancel_pending_can_lose_race_to_fill(fill_status: OrderStatus) -> None:
    result = apply_transition(
        OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING,
        OrderEvent(fill_status, filled_qty=D("0.25")),
    )
    assert result.accepted
    assert result.status is fill_status
    assert result.filled_qty == D("0.25")


def test_unknown_requires_broker_lookup_to_resolve() -> None:
    unverified = apply_transition(OrderStatus.UNKNOWN, OrderEvent(OrderStatus.ACCEPTED))
    assert unverified.illegal

    verified = apply_transition(
        OrderStatus.UNKNOWN,
        OrderEvent(OrderStatus.ACCEPTED, broker_lookup=True),
    )
    assert verified.accepted


def test_status_only_updates_never_carry_filled_quantity() -> None:
    accepted = apply_transition(OrderStatus.SUBMITTING, OrderEvent(OrderStatus.ACCEPTED))
    pending = apply_transition(OrderStatus.ACCEPTED, OrderEvent(OrderStatus.PENDING))
    assert accepted.filled_qty is None
    assert pending.filled_qty is None
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="only through fill-bearing"):
        OrderEvent(OrderStatus.ACCEPTED, filled_qty=D("1"))
    status_only_fill = apply_transition(OrderStatus.PENDING, OrderEvent(OrderStatus.FILLED))
    assert status_only_fill.accepted
    assert status_only_fill.filled_qty is None


def test_cancel_and_replace_require_final_broker_confirmation() -> None:
    requested = apply_transition(OrderStatus.ACCEPTED, OrderEvent(OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING))
    assert requested.accepted
    assert requested.status is OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING
    assert requested.status is not OrderStatus.CANCELED

    canceled = apply_transition(
        OrderStatus.CANCEL_PENDING,
        OrderEvent(OrderStatus.CANCELED, broker_confirmed=False),
    )
    replaced = apply_transition(
        OrderStatus.PENDING,
        OrderEvent(OrderStatus.REPLACED, broker_confirmed=False),
    )
    assert canceled.illegal
    assert replaced.illegal


def test_intent_is_immutable_normalized_and_can_derive_stable_client_id() -> None:
    intent = make_intent()
    assert intent.symbol == "AAPL"
    assert intent.account_scope_id == "paper:account-1"
    with pytest.raises((AttributeError, TypeError)):
        intent.symbol = "MSFT"  # type: ignore[misc]
